items: Jason bought 2 stock shares yesterday. The first stock share was at the price of $50 and the second was $10 lower than the first one. Today, the first stock price goes up by 20% while the second stock price drops down by 20%. What is the difference between the values of two stock shares owned by Jason today?

Four babies were born in a hospital on the same day. Sara weighed 6 pounds, Felipe weighed 8 pounds, and Issac weighed 5 pounds. If the total weight was 26 pounds, how many pounds did the last baby weigh?
Mark wants to purchase a few new items for school. The backpack he wants is $50, and the lunchbox he wants is $20. The sales tax is 10%. He has a $100 bill to pay with. What will his change be?

Heat is produced in a car when sitting in the sun. Assuming brown tint will decrease the heat transfer by 20% for each coating, how many coatings should be applied to reduce the overall heat transfer due to sunlight by 30%? Also assume this decrease in heat transfer halves for each application, that is the second coating will decrease heat transfer by 10%, third by 5%, etc.

Christy wants to make 250 cupcakes for her party. Her cupcake recipe is 2 cups of flour, 1/2 cup sugar, 1 cup water, and 1 tablespoon baking powder. Her recipe makes 25 cupcakes total. 1 bag of flour costs $10 for 10 cups, 1 bag of sugar costs $5 for 6 cups, a 20 tablespoon container of baking powder costs $4. How much will it cost for Christy to make 250 cupcakes?

Dani's mom gave her $15 dollars to pick some stuff up from the grocery store. Her mom wants 2 gallons of milk and 1 carton of eggs. A gallon of milk costs $3.50 and a carton of eggs costs $2. How much, in dollars, does Dani have left over after buying what her mom wants?
Frank has 4 friends. He wants to make 3 pies for each of his friends. Each pie will cost him $15 to make. Frank has $150. How much more money will Frank need?

Mushrooms release spores to reproduce and usually release 350 spores. 60% of the spores drift far away from their progenitor as the wind carries them. Half of the remaining spores settle in moist soil near the progenitor mushroom. How many spores end up settling near the progenitor?

Tony is going grocery shopping for cake supplies. He buys 2 boxes of cake mix, 2 cartons of eggs, 1 bag of sugar, and 4 sticks of butter. A box of cake mix costs $3, one carton of eggs costs $2, a bag of sugar costs $6, and a stick of butter costs $1. If the sales tax is 10%, how much money, in dollars, will Tony pay for his cake supplies?

Landon was clocking the temperature all day long. When he went outside at 7 am, the temperature was -5 degrees. Then, when he checked it at 9 am, it had risen 10 degrees. When he checked it at noon, the temperature had risen another 6 degrees. At 3 pm, it had risen another 2 degrees. When the sun set at 5 pm, it had dropped 4 degrees. He checked again at 7 pm and it had dropped another 3 degrees. He checked again at 10 pm, and it was another 2 degrees colder. When he checked his weather app, it said that the wind chill was making the temperature seem 3 degrees cooler than it was. What was the temperature with the wind chill at 10 pm?

Blake owns his own barbershop. He cuts hair at a rate of 3 clients per hour. On Monday he worked 5 hours. Tuesday and Wednesday he worked a combined total of 11 hours. On Thursday he worked 7 hours, and he worled 3 hours on Friday. How many clients did Blake see this week in his shop?

It’s time for parent-teacher conferences and Miss Sunshine has 29 students in her class, 16 female and 13 male students. On Tuesday there are 9 openings in her conference schedule to visit with parents of female students and the remaining will have to be scheduled on Wednesday. Conferences last 15 minutes. How long will Miss Sunshine need to finish the remaining female parent-teacher conferences on Wednesday? Answer in minutes.

Theo's job pays him hourly plus a bonus for each special task completed. Theo worked 6 hours on Monday for $17 an hour and 6 hours on Tuesday for $16 an hour. He completed 20 tasks on Monday at $5 per special task. How much money did Theo make all together?

Tony had a stock of fishes. He started with 180 fishes. He then gave away 40 fishes to his friends. He also gave 30 fishes to his brothers. If he sold half of the fishes and he found 1/5 of the remaining fishes spoiled , how many fishes did he have left?
Yesterday, 10 customers came into Sandra's shop and each bought 15 pairs of socks. There are still 2/3 as many pair of socks left in the shop as bought. How many pairs of socks still remaining?

Zaliaha went shopping for school clothes on a weekend where no sales tax was charged. She bought 5 shirts at $12.50 each and 3 pair of pants at $17.50 each. What is the total amount of money that Zaliaha spent on clothes?

Dominic needs to order pizza for his class. He has 20 students in his class, estimating that each student will eat three pieces of pizza. Each large pizza comes with 12 slices. Each pizza is $20 for cheese and $25 for pepperoni. He is going to order two pepperoni pizzas and the rest of order will be cheese. How much will his total be?
If Rose owned 3 cats, 4 fish, and 2 chickens, how many total legs do her pets have?

Victor has 930 euros to spend on his day trip to Paris. He wants to spend a third on food, a sixth on transportation, a tenth on museums, and a fifth on souvenirs. How much money in euros will Victor have left?

Eva is having a birthday party with her friends. There will be 20 guests at the party. Each guest gets a gift bag with 3 bracelets, 4 erasers, and 2 rings. Eva has five less than twice as many items as she needs to fill the gift bags. How many items does Eva have?

Lucas is planning to distribute 120 storybooks equally among 4 schools for their libraries. After distributing the books, Lucas decides to buy additional bookmarks for each book. If each bookmark costs $0.50 and Lucas has $40 to spend on bookmarks, how many bookmarks can he buy?
Larry drives 30mph for two hours. The he drives 50mph for an additional 30 miles. How many miles did he drive in total?

Kevin and his mom are taking turns driving. Kevin drives first and goes for 4.5 hours at an average speed of 65 miles per hour before he starts to get tired. His mom takes over and drives for 5.5 more hours at an average speed of 55 miles per hour. How far, in total, did Kevin and his mom drive?

Georg lives in a cave and loves eating spiders. Each spider has a nutritional value of 50 calories. If Georg's normal caloric intake per day is 2000 calories, but he wants to lose weight, and reduces his target intake by 250 calories, how many spiders will he need to eat to match his target precisely?

A gas station running a promotion in which they sell unleaded gas at $1.75 per gallon if you buy 25 gallons or more. However, if you buy fewer than 25 gallons, they charge $2 per gallon. Mary buys 28 gallons of gas, and Kelly buys 24 gallons of gas. How much more does Mary spend on gas than Kelly?

A bag of fruits contain 3 apples, some bananas, some oranges, and some peaches. The number of bananas is twice the number of apples. The number of oranges is twice the number of bananas. The number of peaches is 2 less than the number of oranges. Each apple weighs 2 lbs. Each banana weighs 0.5 lbs. Each orange weighs 1.5 lbs. Each peach weighs 2 lbs. What is the total weight of the entire bag of fruits?

Marley orders potatoes for a fast-food establishment. He needs 500 pounds of potatoes. He orders 100 pounds of potatoes for $8.50 per pound from farmer Jack. He orders 150 pounds for $9 per pound from farmer Mike. He orders 250 pounds for $7 per pound from farmer Jane. How much did the potatoes cost Marley in total?
A farmer has 5 times as many chickens as cows. If he has 30 cows, how many animals does he have in total?

Stephanie opened her fan club in January and started charging $10 per month for membership. She gained five new members in January, twelve in February, and seven in March. In April, she raised the monthly membership fee to $15 and lost six members. By the end of April, how much money has Stephanie earned in membership fees?

Imagine your friend owns a flower shop. She sold 25 bouquets of roses for $20 each, 15 potted plants for $12 each, and 10 floral baskets for $25 dollars each. How much money did your friend's flower shop make?

Sarah, Jack, and Wendy are all engaged in reading books throughout the year, but with varying patterns. Sarah consistently reads 5 books each month but takes a break in April and March. In December, she doubles her usual monthly reading. jack consistently reads 3 books each month but in December, he reads only one-fifth of the total number of books Sarah reads in a year. Wendy starts the year by reading 12 books in January and then reads twice as many books as Sarah does in a usual month reading during February, after which she doesn't read for the rest of the year. Calculate the total number of books that are being read in a year.

Aaron has 3 clarinet gigs this week. His first gig will last 4 hours, and he will charge $76 an hour. His second gig will last 7 hours, and he will charge $112 an hour. Aaron's third gig is for a charity, so he will not earn any money, but it will last 5 hours. What will Aaron's average hourly rate this week be?

Elle, Matt, Jenny, Karla and Theo do online freelance work. Last month, Elle made 3 times more than Matt, who made 4 times more than Jenny, who made 3 times what Karla made, who made twice Theo's income. If Theo made $120, how much did Elle make?

Studying for her test, Mitchell had read ten chapters of a book before 4 o'clock. When it clocked 4, Mitchell had read 20 pages of the 11th chapter of the book she was studying from. After 4 o'clock, she didn't read the remaining pages of chapter eleven but proceeded and read 2 more chapters of the book. If each chapter in the book had 40 pages, calculate the total number of pages that Mitchell had read altogether?

George owns a sheep farm with 120 sheep. Every year, he shaves the wool off of all his sheep and every sheep takes 20 minutes to shave. If Georgie has 2 people to shave all the sheep, how many days would it take if they could only work 5 hours a day?

Emily and Bob each have 15 homework problems to finish within the next week. They decide to form a group and solve all the problems together. Emily can do 2 homework problems every day on weekdays (Monday to Friday). Bob can solve 3 problems every day from Monday to Thursday but he is not available on Friday. Emily and Bob will discuss the remaining problems during the weekend. How many problems on average do they need to solve on each day over the weekend?

Stacy and James are participating in a fundraiser together. They need to raise $350 to get the top prize. They are selling cookie dough for $3 a tub, nuts for $5 a container, and chocolate bars for $1 each. Stacy sells a total of 13 tubs of cookie dough, 7 containers of nuts, and 25 chocolate bars. James sells a total of 11 tubs of cookie dough, 12 containers of nuts, and 8 chocolate bars. How many more dollars do they need to sell to get the top prize?

In the shopping cart, there are 5 apples, 4 oranges, 3 bananas and 2 giant pears. Each apple weighs 4 pounds. Each orange weighs 3 pounds. Each banana weighs 2 pounds. Each giant pear weighs 6 pounds. If two bags are used to hold all these fruits and the weights have to be divided equally, what is the weight in pounds that each bag should carry?
Sage bought 9 roses. She bought twice as many violets and three times as many daisies. If each flower cost $3, how much did Sage spend?

Emily is organizing a book drive for her school library. On the first day, she collects 48 books. She continues collecting books for a total of 5 days, and each day she collects 6 more books than the previous day. After the book drive, Emily decides to donate 15% of the total collected books to another school. How many books does Emily donate to the other school?

Melissa is an artist. She has been hired to paint a mural on a wall and needs to buy paint. The wall has a length of 40 feet and a width of 12 feet. If 1 gallon of paint covers 60 sq. feet, how many gallons of paint will she need to buy?

Macy set up a Cash App savings account. From January through May, Macy was able to deposit $150 each month. For June through December, Macy was able to deposit $200 each month. In December, Macy withdrew $253 for Christmas gifts. How much money does Macy have left in her savings account?

Big Meezy is operating a forklift at work. In a single morning, he moved 26 pallets. After drinking two Red Bulls on his lunch break, he was able to move twice as many pallets in the afternoon as he did in the morning. How many total pallets did Big Meezy move?

Jasmine is baking cookies. She bakes 3 dozen oatmeal raisin cookies, two dozen sugar cookies, and 4 dozen chocolate chip cookies. Jasmine gives away 2 dozen oatmeal raisins, 1.5 dozen sugar cookies, and 2.5 dozen chocolate cookies to Mary. She decides to eat 4 cookies, then gives half of the remaining to Sally. How many cookies does she have left?

Ronnie is the editor of her school's newspaper, which is strictly limited to 700 words. She is getting ready to finish a new edition and only needs to write her editorial comment before it is finished. Besides her editorial comment, the newspaper has three articles that are 245, 320, and 95 words in length. If she shortens each article by 15 words, how many words will she have for her editorial commentary?

Brian makes model cars. His collection currently has 45 cars. His sister gives him one car. He gives a car to his friend, Ben. Brian trades one car for another. His dad gives him one as a reward for good grades. Brian accidentally breaks one and has to throw it away. He wins two in a contest. He sells one to pay for his school supplies. He receives 2 cars for his birthday. How many cars does Brian have now?

Josh needs some new hockey gear before the start of the season. He needs new skates that cost $250. He needs new hockey socks that cost 25 dollars. Josh needs a new stick that costs $165. The final gear Josh needs is new gloves, which cost $80. Josh is a smart shopper buying his gear on clearance; the skates are marked 10 percent off, the hockey socks are 4 percent off, and the stick is 20 percent off. How much will Josh spend on his new gear?

Sandra brought tamales to share with her coworkers. She gave 6 tamales each to three coworkers, and she gave 10 tamales to the security guard at the front desk. After this, she had half of her tamales left. How many did she start with?

Marian raises cats for adoption. Over a few years, she raised 62 litters, each of 12 cats. She split the cats into 4 groups to send to adoption agencies. One agency split their group of cats evenly between 3 rooms to meet with hopeful new foster parents. Marian is attached to all of the cats she puts out for adoption and checks up on them every 5 years. If this agency had 50 cats adopted from one room after 5 years, how many cats does the room have left?

Thomas is sorting his clothing after doing the laundry, and needs to fill his sock drawers. He has 7 empty drawers available and each drawer can hold 35 pairs of socks. If he can fill 1/5 of each drawer with the amount of socks he has, how many total socks (not pairs of socks, individual socks), does he have?

Cersei went to the store and bought 8 pies. She bought 3 apple pies, 3 strawberry pies, and 2 pumpkin pies. Her total came up to $134. Each pumpkin pie was $5 more than each strawberry pie. The apple pies cost $18 each. How much did each pumpkin pie cost?

Sarah went grocery shopping. She bought 6 items. The first item was $5. The second item was twice as much as the first item. The third item was $6 less than the second item. The fourth item was half the price of the first item. The fifth item was $1 more than the fourth item. The sixth item was double the fifth item. How much did she spend altogether?

Kian goes to the grocery store and buys apples, bananas, and carrots. Each apple costs $0.50. Each banana costs twice as much as an apple. Each carrot costs half as much as an apple. If Kian buys three apples, two bananas, and two carrots, how much will his total be?
Robby wanted to buy a new video game for $60. He put a quarter away every day for 200 days. How much many more days does Robby need to wait until he can buy the video game?
Freddy's babysitter is twice as old as he is. Freddy's little sister is a quarter his age. If the babysitter is 16, how old is Freddy's sister?
Puck deposited $1,200 in his Roth IRA account. Braine deposited $120 less than twice the amount as Puck. How much did Braine deposit in his Roth IRA?
Johnny has 8 green balls. He has five fewer than twice that in red balls. How many total balls does Johnny have?

Jenny is baking a cake for her mother's birthday. With such a large family, the cake must serve 72 people. Unfortunately, the only recipe she has serves 9 people, and it calls for 3 eggs. A single carton contains 12 eggs. How many cartons of eggs does Jenny need in order to bake enough cakes for everyone coming to the party?

Marcia made cookies with her Grandma during the holidays. They used 20 cups of flour that day. The amount of sugar they used was half as much as the flour. The amount of brown sugar was half as much as the sugar. The amount of chocolate chips was half as much as the brown sugar. The amount of butter was twice the amount of chocolate chips. The amount of walnuts was one-fifth the amount of butter. The amount of pecans was the same as the amount of walnuts. The amount of pistachios was the same as the amount of pecans. If Marcia wants to make a double batch of the recipe, how many cups of combined nuts will she use?

Moriah gets paid $50 per hour as a coder. She worked 68 hours this week as part of the overtime offered. Overtime pays her $75 per hour over 40 hours for that work week. She looked at her paystub and saw she'd taken home $3200 after taxes and insurance deductions. If the insurance deductions are 2% of her paycheck and the four tax-type deductions are split evenly, what percentage of her total paycheck is each tax-type deduction?

Fitz's dad took his team out for dinner to celebrate the big championship win. There are 12 members on the team. Each member and Fitz's dad ordered a meal that costs $20 each. Fitz's dad left a 20% tip for the server. How much did Fitz's dad spent in all?

Students at a high school are selling magazine subscriptions for a fundraiser. Thomas sold 18 subscriptions, and Miranda sold 8 more than he did. Matthew sold twice as many as Miranda. If the magazine subscriptions are worth $5 each, how much money did the three students make for the fundraiser?

A dozen doughnuts costs $12.00 and Avalon would like to purchase two dozen. He also needs to pick up 2 gallons of milk for $3.50 per gallon and a tin of hot chocolate mix for $8.00. If he currently has $20.00 cash on him, how much more money will Avalon need to be able to purchase all of these items?

Steve is playing Minecraft, and he wants to make a full set of diamond armor and weapons. A helmet requires 5 diamonds, a chestplate requires 3 more diamonds than a helmet, leggings require 7 diamonds, and boots require 4 diamonds. A pickaxe requires 3 diamonds, an axe requires 3 diamonds, and a sword requires 1 less diamond than an axe. Steve can only play Minecraft for 2 hours a day and can only find 2 diamonds an hour. How many days will it take for Steve to get enough diamonds for a full set of armor and weapons?

The movie Back to the Future hit theaters on July 3, 1985. The main character, Michael J. Fox, who played Marty McFly was born June 9, 1961. How old was Michael J. Fox on the 30th anniversary of Back to the Future’s release?

Ryan is practicing the piano. He practices for two hours a day on five weekdays and for three hours a day on two weekend days. He did the research and anticipates that to master playing the piano, he has to practice a total of 10,000 hours. Given that he has already been practicing the piano for 53 weeks and that there are 52 weeks in a year, how many extra years does Ryan have to practice to reach mastery? You can assume that he will keep the same practice schedule in additional years.

Charlie has but one hair on his head, but it grows quite fast and has no maximum length. It grows 2 inches every day. Given that Charlie is 5 feet tall, and he's just shaved his head (reducing the length of his one hair to 0 inches), how long will it take (in days) for the hair to be as long as Charlie is tall?

Saltuk bought 10 cotton candies and 6 popcorn packets. He paid $2 per cotton candy and $3 per popcorn packet. He sold both cotton candies and popcorn at $5 per item at a town fair. He donates 10% of his earnings to a charity. How much profit does he make if he sells all of his popcorn and candies?

Matthew is growing tomatoes. He plants 300 seeds. About half of those germinate into a seedling. A third of those go on to bear fruit. Half of the plants grow eight tomatoes each, and the other half grow six tomatoes each. How many tomatoes does Matthew have?

Pauline was hosting a party with five of her friends. She was buying soda and pizza and had a budget of $50. She determined that she needs to buy six sodas, with each costing $3. How many pizzas can she buy with the leftover money if each pizza costs $8?

The Lorax is only summoned when over 300 trees get chopped down in an area. A new wood-chopping company wants to clear a forest and on the first day, they chop down 5 trees. If they double the amount of trees they chop every day, how many days would it take to summon the Lorax?
My Aunt Martha is five times as old as my cousin Brian. Brian is 10 years older than Ashley's dog. Ashley's dog is 7 years old. How old is Aunt Martha?

There are 7 lines in Terminal B. Line one has 53 adults and 15 kids. Line two has 47 adults and 3 kids. Line three has 99 adults and 10 kids. Line four has 85 adults and 34 kids. Line five has 35 adults and 2 kids. Line six has 91 adults and 14 kids. Line seven has 101 adults and 49 kids. How many people are in all of the lines?
Andrew is training for the Olympic trials and swims 1500 meters in 30 minutes every day. One day he only swam for 15 minutes. How many meters did he swim?

Lilly eats her meals in the dining room of her senior community. Usually there are 4 kitchen staff preparing meals and it takes 8 minutes to prepare a meal. Usually there are 6 servers and Lilly waits a total of 5 minutes for a server to take her order and bring her meal from the kitchen. Generally, Lilly takes 30 minutes to eat her meal. So, in total, she expects to be in the dining room 43 minutes. However, on Wednesdays they have only 2 kitchen staff and 2 servers. Assume the time required to prepare a meal is proportional to the number of kitchen staff. Similarly, the time it takes for Lilly to be waited on is proportional to the number of servers working that day. For instance, if there are only half as many staff to perform a task, it takes twice as long to complete it. Since there are fewer staff, on Wednesdays Lilly tries to eat 20% faster to compensate for the added time for food and table service. How much more time does Lilly expect to be in the dining room on Wednesdays compared to a typical day?

Assume a single slice of pizza is considered a single serving, and a large pizza is cut into 12 pieces. You have 28 hungry kids in class, and they claim they each want 3 pieces of pizza, how many pizzas do you need to order?

For Audrey's birthday, she brought 42 cookies for her 21 classmates to share. Each classmate received the same amount of cookies. After lunch, Jack brought cupcakes to celebrate his birthday as well. Each classmate received one cupcake from Jack. How many treats did each student receive that day?
Martha is taking a class with 4 exams; her final grade is the average of all the scores. What is her final grade if she scores 91, 85, 77, and 95 on the exams?

Jesse has to complete 4 TV installation jobs today. Each receiver Jesse installs takes 30 minutes to install and set up. The first job Jesse has is to install 3 receivers. For the second job, Jesse has to install 2 receivers. In the third job, he has to install 5 receivers. For the fourth job, he has to install 4 receivers. How many hours does it take to Jesse to complete his work?

Evan is cleaning up his classroom by collecting chalk. He found 18 full pieces of chalk, 20 half pieces of chalk, and 16 quarter pieces of chalk. Evan has 2 boxes, and one already holds 3 full pieces of chalk. Each box can hold 12 full pieces of chalk. Including the 3 full pieces of chalk already in one of the boxes, how many pieces of chalk will not fit in the boxes?

Tom plants 3 apple trees and 2 orange trees. Each apple tree yields 6 apples and each apple is sold at $3. Each orange tree yields 10 oranges and each orange is sold at $2. Tom spent $20 buying all of these trees. How much profit will he make after selling all the apples and oranges?
Hannah spent $120 on groceries last week. This week she shopped sales and used coupons, and managed to save 20% on the same groceries. How much did Hannah spend on groceries for the two-week period?

A group of archeologists found the fossils of 40 specimens in a year. A fourth of them were triceratops fossils, and there were half as many tyrannosaurus fossils as triceratops fossils. The amount of pterodactyl fossils was equal to a fifth of the triceratops fossils. There was one fewer mammoth fossil than pterodactyl fossils. If the remaining fossils were stegosaurus fossils, how many fossils were from a stegosaurus?

Roger, Jerry, Tina, and Polly all play on a basketball team. In each game, Roger averages 20 points scored. Jerry scores 1.5 times as many points as Roger, and Tina and Polly combine to score twice as many points as Roger and Jerry combined. If they play a team and give up 110 points, how many points will they win by?
Ms. Johnson has the option to buy a refrigerator for $800 cash or make a $200 down payment and then $50 a month for 15 months. How much would she save by paying cash?

Sophia is a spider, which means she has 8 legs. She's been wanting to buy some new shoes, but it's really expensive for her since she needs to buy 4 pairs. Her monthly budget for clothing is $1700. If the shoes Sophia is going to buy are priced at $250 a pair, how much of her monthly budget will remain after the purchase?

Elijah is blowing up balloons. It takes him 15 minutes to blow up 4 balloons. He also wasted 22 additional minutes blowing up balloons that ended up popping and not counting for his overall total. If he successfully blew up 60 balloons, how long did it take him overall?

Brighton is meeting his friend at the park. His mom drove him 12 miles to the park. Later, he and his friend wanted pizza, so his mom drove 16 more miles to the pizza restaurant. After, his mom drove them back home using the same route, so they could have a sleepover. How many miles did they drive altogether that day?

Emily purchased a bag of fruits containing 5 apples and 2 bananas. Each apple weighs 3 pounds and costs $2 per pound. Each banana weighs 2.5 pounds and costs $6 per pound. Moreover, Emily bought 2 plastic bags and each costs $0.5. How much in total did Emily spent on this shopping?

Santina is playing her dad in a basketball game. Her dad wants to give her an advantage, so every basket she scores is worth 3, and every basket her dad scores is worth 2. During the game, Santina scores 9 times, and her dad scores 13 times. How many total points were scored by both players?

Sheri is going shopping for clothing. At the first store, she buys two pairs of jeans for $50.50 each. At the next store, she buys four t-shirts for $15.75 each. Then, she goes to one final store and buys three pairs of socks for $2 each. The sales tax on her total purchase is 5%. After she is done shopping, she takes some of her clothing to be resold. The store buys two bags of her clothing for $12.25 each. How much did she end up spending that day?

Bob recently started a new job. He got paid $128 on the first day. Starting from the second day, the amount he got paid every day was half of the earning of the previous day. How much did Bob earn in total within the first seven days?

Horace is knitting several items of clothing for his grandchildren. He plans to knit 4 socks, 2 sweaters, and 6 scarves. A sock takes 50 grams of yarn to knit, a sweater takes 300 grams, and a scarf takes 200 grams. If a typical ball of yarn contains 400 grams of yarn, and Horace buys as much yarn as he needs to knit everything plus one extra, how many balls of yarn will he purchase?

Timmy needs help with his math homework, and he’s going over right triangles. He understands that exponents are just multiplication over and over again, but he doesn’t understand square roots. He did go over averages not too long ago, so, out of boredom, he decided to average all of the sides squared that he figured out given the problem. The sides of the triangle are 2 and 4, 6 and 9, and 10 & 15. What’s the average measurement of the squared sides?

Bella and Edward are married. Every 2 weeks, they budget $300 for groceries, and they save the leftover money to put towards their vacation fund. They both went to the grocery store last week. Bella's grocery bill was $134, but she had a 25% off coupon. Edward's grocery bill was $73.50, and he did not have any coupons. This week, they went to the store together and spent half as much on groceries. How much money do Bella and Edward have left over from their grocery budget at the end of the week?
Andre purchased bags of apples for his Fall Party. Each bag cost $4.00 He gave the cashier $30 and got $2.00 in change. How many bags of apples did Andre purchase?

Amy starts a new job for the next week. On the first day she can earn $2. Starting from the second day, every day she earns twice as much as the earning of the previous day. How much does Amy earn in total after six days?

As a cashier, Ana must check out 3 people every 10 minutes to keep the line flowing smoothly. She checked out 24 people in 2 hours. How many more people did she need to check out per hour to meet the goal rate?

Roland wants to figure out how many rows are in his local theater. The theater is set up in such a way that there are 20 seats in the first row and 4 additional seats in each consecutive row. The last row has 144 seats. How many rows are there in the theater?

Andre and Eric are playing heads-up poker against each other. They each start with 100 chips but after the first round Eric wins 20 chips from Andre. If Eric wants to have 75% of chips at the end of the second round, how many more chips does he need to win from Andre?

Jeff’s classroom was playing a game. Jeff divided the class into two 4-player teams, and the team with the best average test score would get extra credit equal to double the difference between the two team's scores. After the test, he checked each student’s test score and averaged it according to their team. Team 1: 79, 82, 91, 100 Team 2: 62, 95, 95, 72 How many points of extra credit did the winning team receive?

Alyssa wants to read five books in 30 days. The 1st book has 300 pages, the 2nd book has the same amount of pages as the 5th book, the 3rd book has twice the amount of pages as the 2nd book, the 4th book has the same amount of pages as the 3rd book, and the 5th book has one-third of the 1st book's pages. How many pages on average would she have to read in a day to finish all five books?

Bernie is a street performer who plays guitar. On average, he breaks three guitar strings a week, and each guitar string costs $3 to replace. How much does he spend on guitar strings over the course of an entire year?

DeAndre is a popular musician and has accidentally leaked his personal cell phone number in the lyrics of a song. His fans keep calling him and it's making his phone unusable. Fans call 107 times per hour. He receives calls from his regular contacts twice an hour. If it takes him 2 hours until he gets fed up and changes his number, how many calls will he have received up till that point?
The post office charges 30 cents for some stamps and 40 cents for others. If Joe spent $10 and he bought 20 30-cent stamps, how many 40-cent stamps did he buy?

Bobby and his sister Bonnie combined their allowance of $7 each, so they could buy a movie for $12. They bought $1 containers of fruit salad with the remaining money and split the containers evenly between them. How many containers of fruit salad did they each get?

On Wednesday night, pizza is half off at the bowling alley. Joe will buy three large pizzas this Wednesday when he goes with his family. Each pizza is normally $20. The sales tax is 10%. Joe plans to double the sales tax to leave as a tip. If he pays with a fifty-dollar bill, what will Joe's change be?

The school theater program wants to sell 200 tickets for the spring musical. There are 50 tickets for the front section of the theater that are selling for $25, 100 tickets for the middle of the theater that are selling for $15, and 50 tickets for the back of the theater that are selling for $10. Out of the total 200 tickets, there were 45 front section tickets purchased, 79 middle section tickets purchased, and 37 tickets from the back were purchased. What is the total dollar amount the school theater made from ticket sales?

Minji wants to take her 70-year-old grandma to an all-you-can-eat buffet. The price for adults is $16 and the price is $5 less for senior citizens. How much will it cost for both Minji and her grandma to eat at the buffet?

Harry is joining a marathon that's why he practices and varies his workouts from day to day. He ran 10 meters per hour on Monday. On Tuesday, he ran 50% faster than on Monday. On Wednesday, he ran 60% faster than on Tuesday. On Thursday, he ran 50% faster than he ran on Wednesday. Then on Friday, he ran 50% slower than he ran on Thursday. How fast did Harry run on Friday?
A company ordered 10 pizzas for a holiday party. Each pizza has 8 slices. The engineering team took 2/5 of the slices. How many slices remain?
A skein of yarn has 12 yards in it. Carla used 15 skeins of yarn to make 30 sweaters for her family. How many feet of yarn did she use for each sweater?
A pair of baseball teams played two games against each other. Team A won the first game by 3, and they won the second game by double that amount. How many total points did they win by?

Sam plans to lose some weights in the next seven days. His current weight is 160 lbs. On the first day, he will lose 2 lbs. Starting from the second day, he will lose 1 lbs more than the previous day. However, on the last two days, Sam decides to reward himself and will instead gain 5 lb in weight each day. Assuming that 1 lbs is approximately 454 grams, how much is Sam's final weight in grams after seven days?
Nikki wants 3 times as many earring sets as Jill. Jill has six sets of earrings. Nikki has 12 sets of earrings. How many more sets of earrings does Nikki need?

Launa makes 20 dollars an hour for three weeks straight. After that, she got a 10 percent raise from her manager for 5 weeks. She works Monday through Friday and from 9 am to 5 pm every day, in addition to this, she also got a 150 dollar bonus at the end of 8 weeks. How much did she make 8 weeks?

Trisha gets $75 for dog sitting for an hour. Trisha is looking for a new apartment, but each time she applies for a rental, she has to pay a $150 application fee. How many hours of dog sitting will she need to do if she applies to 4 different apartments to cover the application fees?

Curt has eaten 40% of his daily allotted sodium intake of 2400 mg. He then eats a massive slice of pizza after adding extra salt to it, worth 900 total mg of sodium. How much total sodium has Curt eaten today?

Nina is shopping for school supplies. She decides to buy ten notebooks, ten packs of pens, and five desk organizers. The notebooks are priced at $3 each, the pens are $2 per pack, and the organizers are $8 each. A 10% sales tax is applied at checkout. What is Nina's total?

The letter carrier delivered mail on Saturday with checks for deposit into a checking account and bills for withdrawal from the same account. The current balance is $48. There were six checks in the amounts of $248, $568, $100, $45, $39, and $78 for deposit. There were two bills for withdrawals in the amounts of $102 and $299. What is the new balance after these transactions for deposits and withdrawals?

Elizabeth is trying to clear out all the weeds from her front yard. 27 square feet of the yard is covered in weeds, and each bottle of weed killer can clear 3 square feet of weeds. If each bottle costs $7, how much will Elizabeth need to spend to buy enough bottles to clear all the weeds?

It is prom season! Erica has been saving all year for the perfect prom dress. Each month for 12 months, she has put $50 of her babysitting money into savings for the special day. She has figured out that getting her nails done will cost $43, her hair will cost $67, dinner with friends will cost $123, and pictures before the prom will cost $146. The limo costs $300, but she is splitting the cost with two other friends. How much will Erica have left for the cost of her dress from her savings?

Denice answers her homework while listening to her 225-minute study playlist. After spending 12 minutes on each item, Denice finished answering with 15 minutes remaining time in her playlist. If she rested exactly 10 minutes after every 5 items without pausing her playlist, how many items did she answer?

Juana travels to Cancun and has 2000 pesos to spend on souvenirs. She spends 100 pesos on a souvenir for her dad, 50 pesos on a souvenir for her baby brother, and 250 pesos on a souvenir for her mom. She then traded in her remaining pesos for dollars at the airport, at a rate of 4 pesos per dollar. After that, she spent ¼ of the money on international taxes. How many dollars were left after her trip?

A school's library has four shelves of books. The first shelf has 48 books and the second shelf has twice as many books as the first shelf. The third shelf has 16 fewer books than the second shelf and the fourth shelf has 5 books more than the first shelf. If a student borrows 3 books from the first shelf, 4 books from the second shelf, 5 books from the third shelf, and 2 books from the fourth shelf, how many books are left in the library?

Duane loves barbeque and gets the following at his favorite spot (in lbs): 2 of the BBQ moist brisket, 3 of the brisket burnt ends, 4 of the jalapeno sausage, 5 of the pulled pork, and 8 of the beef ribs. If each item costs $25 per pound, what is Duane's total?

Astra is an astronomer studying a specific region of the sky and documenting changes. Her star grouping began with 986 stars, but light pollution blocked out 245 stars. Astra grouped the remaining stars into 3 constellations that depict animals. Over a few weeks, some of the local light-producing buildings were torn down to allow for the expansion of local wildlife habitats that had seen encroachment t over the years. The loss of the buildings allowed for another 78 stars to shine through. If Astra reworked her constellations by adding an equal number of the newly revealed stars to each one, how many stars made up each constellation?

Troy visits the supermarket to buy groceries. He ends up buying $150 of produce, $25 of eggs and dairy, and $25 of snacks. The prices of items in the store do not include sales tax, which in this state is 10%. How much does Troy need to pay at checkout?
Joey Janela wrestled for a total of two and a half hours over the weekend. If he wrestled 42 minutes on Friday and for 76 minutes on Saturday, how many minutes did he wrestle for on Sunday?

Michael is printing a long document. The document is 50 pages in length and 10% of each page is printed on. Each page is 8.5 inches wide and 11 inches tall. Every square inch printed on requires 2 ml of ink. He also prints a title page that uses ten times the amount of ink as a regular page. What is the total amount of ink (in ml) needed?

John collects toy cars. He has 1,000 in his collection. He is moving and can't take them all with him so he decides to share many of his cars with friends. John gifts 350 of his toy cars to Mark. The next week, he gifts half of his remaining toy cars to Claire. How many toy cars in total did John gift to his friends?

A group of 3 friends went on a treasure hunt. They each came back with pieces of treasure. John found 3 times fewer pieces of treasure than Ben. Ben found twice a many pieces of treasure as Martin. If Martin found 9 pieces of treasure, what is the average amount of pieces of treasure each friend found?

Harold is waiting in line to buy a movie ticket. There are 10 people in front of him, and each person takes half a minute to complete their purchase. Once he reaches the front of the line, Harold realizes he forgot his wallet and runs back to his car to retrieve it, which increases the time it takes for him to buy the ticket to 1 minute instead of half a minute. How long did it take for Harold to get his movie ticket?

Junior was street racing Beau in his Pontiac. They were traveling down the interstate next to each other at 80 miles per hour when Junior increased his speed by 20%. Suddenly, a highway patrolman caught up to them, traveling 7 miles per hour faster than Junior. How much faster was the highway patrolman traveling than Beau?

Working in a manufacturing plant is hard work and requires a sharp mind. Justin is responsible for taking inventory of all the small parts. He counted six more screws than bolts, 26 times as many studs as screws, 336 fewer nuts than studs, half as many washers as nuts, 343 fewer rivets as washers, seven times as many inserts as rivets, and a fourteenth as many standoffs as inserts. If there are 47 bolts, how many total mechanical parts are there?
Tom would like to buy 3 apples, 4 bananas, and 8 oranges. Each apples costs $3. Each banana costs $2. Each orange costs $1.5. How much in total will Tom spend buying all these fruits?
Jeff has a class of 25 students. 1/5 of them are boys and the rest are girls. How many girls are in his class?

Emily starts a new job for the next 6 months. She finishes 2 tasks in the first month. Then the number of tasks Emily finishes each month is twice as many as she does in the previous month. She earns 10 USD per task and 1 USD = 7 RMB. How much will Emily earn in the next six months in RMB?

David is planting a garden. The fence costs $3 a foot. The width of the garden is half the height, which is 18 feet. Half of the garden will use twice as much fence as the other half. How much will the cost of the fence be?

Luna plans to travel to Antarctica. It takes three flights for Luna to arrive at Antarctica. The first flight takes 2.5 hours. The second flight is three times as long as the first flight. The length of the third flight is the average time of the previous two flights. What it the total time in hours for Luna to fly to Antarctica?

Jackie, Serena and Alex type research papers for college students. Serena types 10 pages per hour. Jackie types only half as fast as Serena, while Alex types twice as fast as Serena. They are asked to type a paper having 140 pages. They divide up the task and starting typing all at once. They continue typing until the job is done and everyone stops at the same time. In how many hours will they finish the job?

Jessica is taking a cross country road trip. She has 2,250 miles to drive. Jessica will drive at an average speed of 50 mph (miles per hour) one day, 45 mph the next day, 55 mph the next day, and will alternate at those average speeds until she arrives at her final destination 2,250 miles from her starting point. Jessica plans to drive for a total of 5 hours each day before she stops to sight see in the current town and to rest for the evening. Jessica will also take bathroom and food breaks, and will stop to stretch. The times spent eating and on breaks will not be calculated within the 5 hours so there will be a full 5 hours of driving each day. How many days will it take Jessica to arrive at her destination?

Bart has a music collection. His jazz collection has 35 albums. His contemporary collection has 3 albums. Bart's classical collection has 70 albums. Bart wants to donate 50% of his collection to charity. How many albums will he have left?

Marcus is creating a playlist of his favorite music. The first song is 4 minutes long. The second song is 3 minutes long. The third song is twice the length of the second song. How many seconds will his playlist be in total?

There are 26 apple trees. The amount of orange trees is double the number of apple trees. Suppose the amount of pear trees is double the amount of apple and orange trees combined, and every fruit tree has 12 fruits. If 108 children attempt to split the total amount of fruits evenly, how many fruits will each child get?

Marta has been remodeling two rooms in her house. The rooms are rectangular. Room 1 has a floor plan that measures 8 feet by 12 feet. Room 2 has a floor plan that measures 12 feet by 15 feet. She has a budget of $2000 and plans to purchase and install carpeting and a door in each room. She also wants to replace one of the windows which costs $600, but does not have enough money in her current budget. If the price of carpeting with tax and installation fees is $4 per square foot and the cost of each door with tax is $225, how much more money will she need to replace the window?
There are 120 pieces of fruit. If 1/5 of the fruits are apples and 1/4 of the fruits are pears, how many fewer apples are there compared to pears?

Leo is trying to perfect his free throws when he plays basketball. He wants to try to shoot 200 free throws a day, but he figures he should have rest days too. Leo decides to chart his free throw percentage across a 4 week period. The week will begin with Monday and end with Sunday, and Leo will take rest days on Wednesday, Saturday and Sunday. On the remaining days, Leo will shoot 200 free throws. The first week, Leo made 87 free throws on Monday, 98 on Tuesday, 85 on Thursday, and 99 on Friday. The following week, Leo made 107 on Monday, 104 on Tuesday, 99 on Thursday, and 109 on Friday. The third week he made 110 on Monday, 115 on Tuesday, 122 on Thursday, and 118 on Friday. The final week he made 128 free throws on Monday, 127 on Tuesday, 136 on Thursday, and 147 on Friday. By what percentage did Leo's free throw accuracy increase from week 1 to week 4? Round percentages to the nearest 1.

Francis is a health nut and loves to stay fit, so he is always drinking protein shakes. He makes a total of 224 ounces of protein shakes once per week. If he drinks 2 shakes every day and each shake contains 48 grams of protein, how many grams of protein are in each ounce?

Josie can fit 3 apples (sliced and cubed) into the Tupperware she uses for lunch each of the 5 days she works. Apples are on sale, so Josie buys 70 apples. How many does Josie have left after a week of work?

Stacy is waiting for her apartment building's office staff to return from lunch. The sign on the door indicates that they'll return in 20 minutes. She's expecting to have a 5 minute meeting with them and then she needs to go to her physical therapy appointment on the side of town. She has to be there in one hour. She knows her physical therapist is 10 miles away and her average speed along the way will be 30mph. If she takes a 5 mile detour, at the same speed, to look at the lake, how many minutes early does she expect to arrive to her physical therapist?

Carrie wants to challenge herself to read more over the summer. She decided for the next 8 weeks, she will read an additional 55 pages on top of the 75 pages she is reading daily. The average book is 364 pages. One-fifth of the books are fiction, and the rest are historical fiction and nonfiction. What's the average number of books left to read between the last two genres?

Patrick is planning a birthday party for his daughter. He wants to buy balloons and cupcakes for the party. Each balloon costs $2 and each cupcake costs $3. He wants to have 3 balloons for each guest and 2 cupcakes for each guest. If he invited 10 guests, how much would he spend on balloons and cupcakes?
Harry wants to buy 5 dozen eggs. He sees two types selling at $3.60 and $4.20 a dozen each. What would be the difference between buying 5 dozen of each type?

Jamie was coordinating an engagement photoshoot for several clients. She sold three different packages, and the client could buy one, two, or all three. The small package was $25, the medium package is $35, the grand package is $50, and she is running a promotion that gives the client all three for $80. Jamie is also passionate about animals and decided to donate 20% of her revenue to a local shelter. If she has 10 customers, of which 5 buy all three, 3 buy the small and medium packages, and the last 2 buy only the medium package, how much did she donate to the shelter?

Ann is shopping for her soccer team. Jerseys are $22 each for 15 team members. Plus, Ann decides to buy 14 knee pads at $15 each. Ann must include the 5% sales tax. The sales clerk informs Ann that she has a $20 store credit from last year which can be applied to today's total. Ann pays with $550 cash. How much change will Ann get back?

Ellie wants to paint the floor of her room. She needs to buy paint. Her room measures 22 feet by 22 feet and she knows one can of paint will cover 44 square feet. How many cans of paint should she buy?

Frank loves baking and decides to bake 80 cookies on Saturday and 40 cookies on Sunday. He gives 20% of the cookies away to his neighbor. After giving the cookies to his neighbor, he takes 50% of the remaining cookies he has left to a bake sale. He sells each cookie for 50 cents. How much would he make if he sold all his cookies?

A store is having a sale on t-shirts and shorts. The t-shirts are on sale for $15 each and the shorts are on sale for $20 each. If I buy 3 t-shirts and 2 pairs of shorts, and I have a coupon for $10 for my total purchase, how much will I spend?
Trickie earned $256 from lawnmowing. Tracie earned thrice as much as Trickie earned. How much money did the two girls earn together?
Carlos has a 500 mL jug of water that he wants to fill up. If the jug is already a quarter full, how many mL would it take to fill it up?

Benjamin set aside four hours to study for his economics test. He spent 35 minutes on each of his first four topics, and he has one more left to study. How many minutes does he have to study his last topic?

For the past week, Arun has been keeping track of his daily step count. He walked 6,000 steps a day for two days. Then he picked up his speed and walked 7,500 steps a day for one day. He again went back to 6,000 steps a day for two days. He decided to ease off over the weekend and limit his daily step total to 4,000. How many steps did Arun take in total over the week?
Dad was eight times older than Bob. Bob was twice the age of Dylan. Mom was three years older than dad, and Mom's age was 51. What was Dylan's age?

There are 84 bench seats on the Polar Express Train. A quarter of the bench seats have two people sitting on them. The remaining bench seats have three people sitting on them. The maximum number of people the train can hold is 250 people. At the next stop, what is the largest number of people that can board the Polar Express Train?
A factory is manufacturing clay pots. Out of 200 clay pots made, 20 percent were damaged. Ten percent of the damaged clay pots can be repaired. How many clay pots are not repairable?

It snowed two inches per hour in Stowe from midnight until 4:00 AM. Then it continued to snow one inch per hour until 9:00 AM, then eased up to a flurry of 1/4 inch per hour until 5:00 PM, when the snow stopped. How many inches of snow did Stowe receive today in total?
Sylvia buys 3 pairs of pants and 5 shirts. If each piece of clothing was $5, how much did she spend?

Alex is planting shrubs, trees, and flowers for the spring. He finds a store that sells trees that cost $75 each, the flowers that he wants at a fifth of the tree's cost, and a shrub set that costs six times a tree's cost. Alex has $990 to spend on plants. He buys 1 shrub set, 4 trees, and 12 flowers. How much money does Alex have left if he decides to buy more plants?

Ricky and Shane are getting their friends together to watch March Madness. They’re trying to organize lunch and dinner for their 10 friends (12 people total). For lunch, they decide to get 5 pizzas, 4 orders of fries, and 8 bottles of soda. Each pizza costs $15, fries cost $7, and soda costs $4. They also tip the delivery driver $10. For dinner, they decide to order tacos, chips, and salsa. They order 20 tacos for $3 each, 5 orders of chips for $4 each, and 3 cans of salsa for $2 each. They also tip the delivery driver $9. If each friend paid an equal amount and each brought $25, how much did each friend have left over?

Merely the Messenger is seeking social media influencers who will share their follower lists for Facebook and Instagram platforms. Dylan has 1,592 Facebook followers and 5,290 Instagram followers. Sam has 6,923 Facebook followers and 4,297 Instagram followers. Ben has 2,873 Facebook followers and 6,925 Instagram followers. Seth has 7,578 Facebook followers and 3,487 Instagram followers. Natasha has 2,458 Facebook followers and 6,873 Instagram followers. Brent has 1,485 Facebook followers and 9,876 Instagram followers. Rebecca has 3,587 Facebook followers and 9,964 Instagram followers. How many followers in all for both Facebook and Instagram?

The school is doing a fund raiser, 65 milk chocolate pieces and 55 dark chocolate pieces were. At the end of the day, there was a total of 32 pieces left. Each chocolate piece was sold for 2.25. How much did they raise?

West has a nail in 3 tires that causes them to lower by 3psi per day. When they reach 19 psi, he must refill them to their maximum capacity of 34 psi. It costs $1 per minute to pump air at his local gas station, and he can pump 5psi of air in one minute. How much money, in dollars, will he spend on his tires in one month, assuming a month has 30 days?

Gary plans to stay in a hotel, see some shows, and eat some great meals during their trip to New York City. They want to stick to a budget of $1000. The hotel room costs $200 a night on Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, or Thursday night. On Friday or Saturday night it costs $250 a night. On Sunday night it costs $225 a night. Gary wants to see a Broadway show that costs $100 a ticket and another one that costs $75 a ticket. Gary has a coupon for 10% off if they book both the hotel and the shows as a package. After the discount is applied, Gary will also receive a coupon worth $10 towards meals. If Gary plans to stay for Saturday, Sunday, and Monday nights at the hotel and see both shows, how much will remain in the budget for meals?
Tissues cost $8 for four rolls. How much would Liam spend if he bought 12 rolls of tissue?

Penelope is a big coin collector. She opened her piggy bank to count the coins she had. When she opened it, she had 35 quarters, 16 dimes, 25 nickels, and 40 pennies. She was hoping to buy two new toys. Each toy costs $10.00. How much more does Penelope need to save to be able to buy both toys?
Patricia starts off her math class with a 69 on her first exam. She takes two more exams; she gets a 75 and scores 3 points more on her last exam. What's her average now?

Claire runs a delightful fruit shop. She sells crates apples, oranges, bananas, strawberries, blueberries, and tomatoes. Her apple crates are $36, her orange crates are $72, and her banana crates are $54. The strawberry, blueberry, and tomato crates cost a third as much as each of the preceding three fruits respectively. The fruit market has been booming lately and Claire was able to further reduce the prices of her strawberry, blueberry, and tomato crates down to a sixth of their starting price. What is the average price, in dollars, of the strawberry, blueberry, and tomato crates after the price reduction?

Arnold and Anthony are playing a close game of chess. The time is running down, and with 60 seconds on his clock, Arnold starts trying to find a checkmate. Although he sees a certain checkmate in 6 moves, Arnold had to spend 36 seconds of his remaining time to find the correct moves and responses. What is the most amount of time (in seconds) Arnold can spend making each move in the checkmate sequence in order to not lose?

Monica and Sean are knitted scarves for the poor. Monica knitted a total of 12 scarves and Sean knitted 15. Monica knitted 5 yellow, 5 red, and 2 blue. Sean knitted 5 red, 4 yellows, and 6 blue. Monica really liked Sean's knitted design and decided to trade with him. Monica gave Sean 2 yellow scarves for 3 blue scarves. Sean decided to trade with Monica for 2 of her red scarves and 2 yellows. How many yellow and blue scarves combined does Monica have?

Becky is making baby back ribs for a Memorial Day cookout. She needs 16 ounces of Sweet Baby Ray's BBQ Sauce for each rack of ribs. If she orders 6 economy-size bottles of the sauce that each contain 48 ounces, how many racks of ribs will she be able to make?

Sneha bought 30 oranges at 2$ each. She sold 10 oranges at twice what she bought them for. She ate 5 oranges herself. The rest of the oranges were sold at the same price she bought them for. How much profit does she make in total?

A hotel charges a $12 fee per room for optional cleaning services. Out of the hotel's 76 occupied rooms, 75% of them have opted into the cleaning services. How much money is the hotel making from this cleaning fee?

Jimmy is at an arcade and wants to earn enough tickets to get a good prize. He earns 15 tickets from a basketball arcade machine and 7 times that amount from a claw machine. If Jimmy wants a prize that costs 450 tickets, how many more will he need to earn?

Ben's mobile dog grooming service has the following inventory in stock: 16 hairbrushes at $12.99 each; 13 bottles of shampoo at $8.97 each, 13 bottles of conditioner at $8.97 each, 22 bottles of pet fresh lavender spray at $14.50; and 6 pink bows at $4.99 each. If all of the items are sold today, how much will Ben make in sales?

Arielle plants two trees in her yard. One tree is 4 feet tall and the other is 6 feet tall. Three years later, the smaller tree has doubled in height and the taller tree has grown 4 feet. After three years, what is the average height of the two trees?

Sophie was been commissioned to paint a mural in downtown. She needs 210 buckets of paint, she needs equal amounts of paint buckets for each color. She has 34 red paint buckets, 39 blue paint buckets, 28 yellow paint buckets. Now she has to go to the store to buy these colors. How much will it cost her when each paint bucket is $25?

Officer Sherry's precinct has lots of criminal activity. When she comes in to make an arrest, she yells, "HANDS IN THE AIR," and counts the number of hands raised in the air to get an idea of how much time she'll spend fingerprinting. This week, she knew she was going to arrest the Peterson crime family, whose family averages 3.5 fingers per hand due to their dark, criminal past. The Rhodes crime family was also at the station waiting to be booked, and they averaged 5 fingers per hand. Sherry can fingerprint 3 fingers in a minute and it takes 30 minutes to finish paperwork. If there were 20 hands from the Peterson family and 13 from the Rhodes family, how many minutes did it take her to finish her paperwork and fingerprint all the criminals?

Jin has $60 to spend on books. He picks 4 books from a discount bin. One book is originally priced at $12 and has a discount of $2. The second book is priced at $10 but is 10% off. The third book is $20 and has a 25% discount. And the fourth book is originally priced at $20 and has a $3 discount. How much money does Jin have left in his budget?
It has been snowing! On Monday, 2.5 feet fell. On Tuesday, it fell twice as much. It takes Ben 1 minute to shovel 10 inches of snow. How many minutes will it take him to shovel the snow?

Tommy is watching the calendar and counting the days until Spring Break! Fort Worth ISD observes spring break from March 11 to March 15, a total of 5 days. Tommy plans to spend each day playing Fortnite during the hours he’d normally be at school for 7.5 hours, from 8:15 a.m. until 3:45 p.m., less the one-half hour for lunch, which leaves 7 hours of regular instruction time he instead can use to play Fortnite. When Tommy’s mother learns of his plans, she schedules him to go help his grandmother with house cleaning on Tuesday and Thursday of his Spring Break week. How much time will Tommy spend playing Fortnite? Answer in the number of total gaming hours.

Eddie buys two tickets to his favorite show for $300 each. The day before his show, he gets a last-minute assignment out of town and has to resell his tickets. His friend buys one ticket from him for (¾) of the cost. Another friend buys the second ticket for (½) the price plus $25 in processing fees. How much money, in dollars, did Eddie lose from his original purchase?

The math department needs to hiring some Teaching Assistants (TAs) for 3 undergraduate math courses: Calculus, Linear Algebra, and Statistics. In the Calculus course, there are 5 different sessions and each session has to be equipped with 3 TAs. The Linear Algebra course comes with 4 different sessions and 2 TAs need to be hired for each session. The Statistics course only has 1 session but 5 TAs are requested for this course. In addition, the math department has to hire 1 grader for each session of these three courses. How many TAs and grader in total will the math department hire for the three undergraduate math courses?

Ava and Evelyn start a business selling handmade jewelry. Ava makes necklaces in 20 minutes each. Evelyn makes bracelets in 10 minutes each. They sell the necklaces for $10 each and bracelets for $5 each. On Monday they work on making jewelry for 2 hours total and then on Wednesday they make more jewelry for 1 hour. They sold everything they made. How much money did they make?

The city needs to build a road that is 1500 meters long. They have already finished 300 meters, however, the county has requested that the rest need to be done in six days. On average, how many meters dose the city have to build each day?

John has 10 math problems and 12 physics problems to solve within the next five days. He solves 2 problems on the first day. From the second to the fourth day, every day he solves 2 more problems than the previous day. How many problems are left to be solved on the last day?

Anahita ate 4 slices of pizza. Her sister ate only 1 slice of pizza. Anahita's father ate exactly the same number of slices that Anahita ate; while her mother ate one more than half of all the slices that Anahita ate. The pizza is now gone. How many slices were there in the pizza?

Andrew has 6 peaches. Bob has 2 more peaches than Andrew. Cathy has twice as many peaches as Andrew. Andrew first gives 1/3 of his peaches to Bob. Then Bob gives 1/5 of his peaches to Cathy. How many peaches does Cathy have in the end?

Oliver is organizing his bookshelf and decides to sort his books into three categories: mystery, fantasy, and science fiction. He has twice as many fantasy books as mystery books and three times as many science fiction books as fantasy books. If Oliver has 5 mystery books, how many books does he have in total?

Ashley was driving along the interstate in the desert and her truck broke down. She called A-1 Towing Service and the said they will help her and that they charge $35.00 for driving to the scene of the truck break down, plus $7.00 for each mile they have to tow her truck. To get from Ashley's truck's location on the interstate to the repair shop, A-1 Towing Service had to tow her truck for 25 miles along the interstate. Then, they turned North and towed her truck for 2/5 of the number of interstate miles. Then, they turned East and towed Ashley's truck 12 miles more than they did when they drove North. Finally, the tow truck turned North again and drove 17 miles less than when they towed her truck East. Ashley paid the total towing bill with $500.00. How much change, in dollars, did she receive back?

Rats have infested Courtney's house, and they're after her cheese! She owns 3 wheels of parmesan, 17 wheels of cheddar, and 1 wheel of brie. If the rats pilfer her cheeses at the rate of 3 wheels per night, how many nights will pass until Courtney is bereft of any cheese at all?

The price of a water bottle was 60 dollars. It increased by 10 percent in the first week, decreased by 25 percent in the second week, and then increased by 100 percent in the third week, what was the water bottle's final price?
Andrew bought 2 cups of Latte ($5 each), 4 cups of Cappuccino ($4 each), and 3 cups of Americano ($3 each) for his group members. How much did Andrew spend in total?
Anika's age is half of that of her sister Anahita. Anahita's age is 6. What will be their combined age five years from now?

Barry and Patrick are jogging along the same route. Barry jogs at a rate of 4 miles per hour. Patrick jogs slower than Barry, at 3 miles per hour, but he got started earlier than Barry and is 6 miles ahead of him. How many hours will it take until Barry catches up with Patrick?
Dan loves running and does so most days. His class is 5 miles from his house, and he runs there and back on days when he has class. If he has class four times a week, how many miles does Dan run?

Kendall and Destiny are training for an upcoming marathon. They both started their training by running 5 miles a day. They were able to finish their initial run in 36 minutes. A week into training, Kendall got sick and decided to stay home. Once he recovered, he returned to training only to find out that Destiny was able to finish in half the time as their initial run, while he took 3 times longer than her. How long, in minutes, did Kendall take to run 5 miles after he got sick?

A plane owned by Sunny Skies Airlines is flying from Indianapolis to Phoenix. The plane holds 180 passengers and is 2/3 full. Each passenger brings 2 carry-on bags and is charged a carry-on bag fee of $35 per bag. How much money does Sunny Skies Airlines collect for the carry-on bag fees for this flight?

Sudah collected aluminum cans for recycling. The local recycling center paid Sudah $2.00 for every 160 cans she collected. She placed a collection box at three different locations: the church, the diner, and the grocery store. At the church, Sudah collected 200 cans. At the diner, Sudah collected 30% more than she did at the church. At the grocery store, Sudah collected 70% more than she collected at the church. How much did Sudah get paid for recycling aluminum cans?
Shawn owns 8 rows of carrot crops. Each annual carrot season he harvests 24 carrots per row. How many carrots does Shawn produce in 4 years?
Josh purchased 3 video games with his weekly allowance: one for $25, one for $14, and one for $18. He hands the cashier a $100 bill. Josh receives what amount of change back?

Aaron wants to buy five fish at the pet store and is looking for a tank big enough to hold them. He knows that the tank needs 1 gallon of water for every inch of fish. Assuming all fish are the same length, how many inches would each one be if he walked out with a 20-gallon tank?

Leilani has four different types of pets. She has three times as many dogs as she does cats. She has five less cats than she does hamsters. The amount of hamsters she has equates to half a dozen, a dozen being 12. How many dogs does she have?

Jake wants to watch the football game at 2:15pm at the lounge. He usually wakes up at 9:45am and takes him 30 minutes to drive to the lounge. How many hours does Jake have before he has to leave to watch the game in time?

Lucy is trying to save money for a new skateboard that costs $150. She receives $25 for her birthday from her grandmother, and her parents doubled that amount to give to her. She had $30 in her bank account last month, and she earned 10% interest. How many dollars does Lucy still need to buy her skateboard?
Joe and Sam have too many loaves of bread. They need to bring back 2 loaves each and they have 50 loaves in total. How many loaves do they have to give away?
Someone becomes indebted every 30 seconds, and someone files for bankruptcy every 40 seconds. In 4 minutes, how many people will have debt overall?

John will have 2 trips in the coming month. In the first trip, he will take 2 short trains (45 minutes each) and 3 long buses (30 minutes each). In the second trip, he will take 2 flights (1.5 hours each) and a 30-minute light rail. How long (in minutes) in total will John spend on transportation in these 2 trips?

Horizon Elementary is doing its annual fudge fundraiser. 65 pounds of chocolate fudge was sold at $8/lb. 38 pounds of white chocolate fudge sold at $6.50/lb. 48 pounds of dark chocolate fudge sold at $9.75/lb. The total money raised was $1235. What was the highest sale of fudge?

Kayla wants to buy a computer that cost $1000, and a gaming keyboard with mouse that is half the cost of the computer. She also plans to get speakers that are a quarter of the cost of the keyboard and mouse. If the store is discounting your total purchase at $100 off. What is the total amount that she will pay?

A class of middle school students is taking a placement test to determine if they will attend an advanced class next semester. Half of the students who take the test pass and qualify for placement into the advanced class. Of those who pass, 6 decide to not attend the class. After the next semester starts, half of the students in the advanced class drop it after seeing their first exam results. Mid-way through the semester, 3 transfer students join the advanced class. If, at the end of the semester, there are 22 students in the advanced class, how many more students were in the original class?

Amy is the family's teacher's pet and scored 93, 100, and 95 on her last three exams. Phil is the younger brother who hates being in Amy's shadow and gets an 88, 92, and 96 in the same class. How far apart are their exam averages?

Jason has 12 gallons of gas in his car, and he uses 2 gallons per day. Amy's car has 15 gallons of gas, and she uses 3 gallons per day. How many more days will Jason's car run than Amy's car without running out of gas?

The Smith family took out a home equity line of credit (HELOC) on their home. When the family took out their HELOC, they borrowed $100,000 at a rate of 3% interest. The market changed and they still owed $100,000 with a new interest rate of 9%. How much more is the monthly interest payment at 9%, than it was at the 3% rate?

Conny orders a wedding cake with different additions. 4 Layers, 2 cake toppings, 12 decorative flowers, 2 different cake flavors, and 10 fondant lace details. The bakery charges $30 per cake layer, $10 per cake topper, $6 per decorative flower, $30 per cake flavor, and $12 per fondant lace detail. How much money is Conny's cake going to cost?

Jake makes cakes at the Westlake Cake Bakery. He has a stock of 560 cakes that he baked before leaving last night, and he decides to bake the same number plus an additional 50% that day. He gets a big order for 500 cakes to be delivered later that day and decides to shake and bake double the number he has left after the order. Jake leaves for the day, baked with pride and exhaustion, and heads home. On the way home, he realized he'd made a mistake: he forgot to bake cakes for an order he left in its wake. He heads back to the cake bakery, splits his stock into four equal parts, and delivers one of those to his customer. Jake is awake and makes an executive decision to not make the same mistake again. He decides that tomorrow he wants to bake double what he started with today and calculates how much he has against how much he wants to make. How many cakes does Jake need to bake tomorrow to feel great?

A large regional church is hosting an Easter egg hunt for the children in the community and as a fundraiser for their spring missions. The church plans to hide 5000 eggs. They will hide pink, yellow, green, and blue eggs for the children to find. Each type of egg represents funds that were donated to the church by the community members. Each pink egg represents a donation of $5; there are 821 pink eggs. Yellow eggs represent a donation of $10; there are 911 yellow eggs. Green eggs represent a donation of $20; there are 1,222 green eggs. Blue eggs represent a donation of $50; there are 2,046 blue eggs. All of the eggs were filled with a piece of candy that cost 10 cents. For the event, the church is renting 3 inflatable bounce houses that cost $600 each. How much profit will the church make from the event to go towards their spring missions?

Emily is going to give out 40 candies to her students. There are 20 students in Class I, where 1/2 of students can get candies. Class II has 30 students, where 1/3 of them can receive candies. Class III has only 15 students but 2/3 of them can get candies. How many candies will be left with Emily?

Micah is making bouquets for her friend. She wants to make 8 bouquets with 10 flowers each. She collects 4 daisies, 10 roses, and 2 tulips outside her house. Her friend gives her 4 bouquets of 6 flowers each to help her. Her cat eats ¼ of her flowers, so she goes out and collects 14 more. How many flowers does she have now?

Vera is in charge of the annual cookie drive for her troop. Each year, each of the five girls receive an initial shipment of 250 boxes of cookies. Carol requested 469 additional boxes. Felicia requested 269 additional boxes. Joannie request 86 additional boxes. Wanda requested 677 additional boxes. Ashley requested 147 additional boxes. How many boxes of cookies did Vera's troop need in all?

Ash, Misty and Brock are three Pokemon trainers trying to become the best that ever was. Brock caught three times as many Pokemon than Ash caught, and Ash caught half as many Pokemon than Misty caught. If Misty caught 90 Pokemon, how many Pokemon did the three trainers catch altogether?

Walter is making pizzas for his friends. 2 of the pizzas have 3 pepperonis per slice. 3 pizzas are vegetarian. They have 2 mushrooms and 4 olives per slice. The final 2 pizzas are Hawaiian, and have 2 chunks of pineapple and 3 bits of ham per slice. If each pizza has 8 slices, how many toppings are there in total across all the pizzas?

A coal miner is loading up coal into mine carts. During the first hour of the day, he is able to load 15 carts. His boss yells at him after that, so for each of the next three hours, he loads twice as many carts. Each cart weighs 78 pounds. What was the total weight of the coal he loaded on this day?
Emily started a dog walking business. She charges $5 for each dog. On Monday's she walks 6 dogs and on Saturday's she walks 8 dogs. How many dollars does she make in a week?
Brie received $100 for her birthday. She put it in her savings account, which had a $50 balance. The next week, she bought a dress for half her savings. How much of her savings does she have left?
Wade has $80 to spend on baseball tickets. Each ticket costs 23.00. He needs to buy 3 tickets. How much money will he have left to buy snacks with at the game?

Maggie is going school supply shopping. At her local store, the pens cost $1 each, notebooks cost $3 each, and the calculators are $8 each. The store has a sale going on that for every three items you buy, you get a $2 discount. Maggie decides to buy 10 pens, 4 notebooks, and 2 calculators, what is her total?
Lily buys 2 concert tickets that cost the same amount. She resells them for $318 and makes a $100 profit. How many dollars did each ticket originally cost?
A box of chocolate contains 2 trays of chocolate. Each tray has 18 chocolates. They started off with 100 boxes, now they have 35 left. How many pieces of chocolate are left?
A recipe calls for 3 cups of flour to make a dozen cookies. How many cups of flour are needed to make 36 cookies?

A police officer has a policy of only writing tickets for 60% of people he pulls over. Over a five-day period, he pulled over an average of 16 people per day. How many tickets did he write during this period?
Tom, Dick, and Harry finished a giant bag of chips. Tom had 100 chips, Dick had half of that, and Harry had twice as many as Tom. How many chips were in the bag?
Sara invited 20 friends and Jim invited five friends to a party, but only 80% of their friends showed up to be with Sara and Jim. Including Jim and Sara, how many people showed up to the party?

The Disco Biscuits played 72 concerts this year, and each concert was two sets. During a quarter of these sets, the Disco Biscuits played the song Helicopters. How many times did they play Helicopters this year?

Amy loves playing guitar and wants to learn new songs in the coming week. She plans to learn 2 songs on Monday. Starting on Tuesday through Friday, Amy can learn 4 more songs than the previous day. On Saturday and Sunday, the number of songs Amy plans to learn each day is the average of the previous two days. How many songs will Amy learn on Sunday?

Tim and Blake are trying to figure out if they have enough money in their budgets to afford movie tickets. Tim's budget starts with $400 to spend for the month. Upon checking his bank statement he sees that he already spent $125 on groceries and $50 on shoes this month. Additionally, he know we will still have to pay $50 for his utilities bills this month and needs to leave $100 for groceries for the rest of the month. Blake's budget is simpler. He starts with $150 and has already spent $64 on new clothes this month. He does not have to buy groceries but will need $40 for his utility bill. How much money in total can they spend on movie tickets?
Mark makes $1000/week working 30 hours. He also gets $290 as a bonus. How much is his hourly rate with his bonus included?

Gio is cleaning out his game closet. He found some five decks of cards that contained the following number of cards: 51, 50, 47, 49, and 52. There were supposed to be 260 cards altogether. How many cards is Gio missing?

Yana and Janice live in opposite cities. They decided to meet 10 km closer to Yana's place. Janice travels in a car that requires 2 liters of fuel for a 15 km drive while Yana requires 1.2 liters of fuel to travel 9.5 km. If the halfway point between their places is 200 km, how many more liters of fuel does Janice need compared to Yana?

Susan needs a new dress for the sweetheart dance. She has found a dress she loves, but it costs $150. Susan's mom has a card good for 20% off at the dress store. Sales tax in Susan's city is 7.5%. If Susan also needs to budget for a $25 dinner with a 20% tip, how much money should she save for the dance altogether?

Kyle is going to the arcade, and he is trying to win as many tickets as possible. He can play a basketball game for a quarter and win 10 tickets. He can play a hockey game for twice the price and win three times as many tickets. Kyle spends $1.25 and plays a total of three games and plays each game at least once.
