He plans on using the tickets he wins to buy a yo-yo, which costs 30 tickets. How many tickets will he have left over after buying the yo-yo with his tickets?
Larry really likes cheese. He ate six pieces on the first day, 50% more on the second day, and double the amount of the second day on the third day. How many pieces of cheese did Larry eat in total?

Jackie makes $25/hour as a receptionist at a law firm. Jackie works full-time 40 hours a week. Two weeks a month, she works four hours of overtime. Her overtime rate is 1.5x her hourly rate. Assuming that the month has four weeks, how much does Jackie make in a month?
Sarah works every day to earn $500 and spends 3 hours at a spin class that costs $12 per hour. How much money does she have after 4 days?

Ruby is starting 1st grade this year and has a classroom supplies list. She needs 50 sheets of paper and a dozen pencils. Paper costs $0.02 for a sheet, but pencils cost $0.25 a piece. What is the price of Ruby's school supplies?

Julian has a budget of $6,000 for the renovation of his kitchen. He is going to spend 1/3 of that budget on countertops and 1/2 of the budget on a contractor. How much will be left over for him to use for appliances?

Ray works in a chicken stall. On a Saturday, he sells a total of 43 kg of chicken, and on Sunday, he sells a total of 50 kg of chicken. If the rate of chicken on Saturday was $3/kg and the chicken on Sunday was $5/kg, how much money did he make for these two days in total?

Jane has a "low fuel warning" light show up in her car; she has a range of 50 miles left before it's empty. If she's traveling at 60 mph, how much time in minutes does she have until she runs out of gas?

Andre spends 1.5 hours on homework each night from Monday through Thursday. On Sundays, he spends twice as much time on homework than he does on a weekday. He spends one-third as much as much time on homework on Saturdays as he does on Sundays. He works on Fridays after school for 4.5 hours. He works 2 hours longer on Saturday and two-thirds as long on Sunday as he does on Friday. How many more hours does he spend working each week than he spends on homework?

Veronica can crochet 1 whale plushie with 5 hours of work. To make the whale plushie, she must spend $7 on supplies for each plushie. Veronica is preparing to sell her whale plushies at a market, which requires a $50 fee to attend as a vendor. If Veronica spends 75 hours making whale plushies, and she sells the whale plushies for $22 each, how much money will Veronica earn if she sells all of her whale plushies at the market?

It takes Jack 5 minutes to brush her teeth, 15 minutes to take a shower, 20 minutes to cook breakfast, and 10 minutes to make coffee. Assume Sarah takes twice the time as Jack at each task, how much time does Sarah have to cut off to be 10 percent faster than Jack?

Norah would like to donate her hair. To donate her hair, she has to have a full 12 inches to cut and share. Norah does not like to have her hair short, so she will need it to be 36 inches long before she will cut it to donate the 12 inches. Right now her hair is 28 inches long. Her hair grows at 1/2 an inch per month. How many months will it take before Norah can cut and donate her hair?
Shaun has 56 quarters and 60 nickels in his backpack. How much money in dollars does he have?

Bethany is ordering pizza for a gathering of friends. There are 10 people there, and each person will eat 4 slices over the course of the day. Each pizza has 8 slices. If Bethany wants to buy exactly enough so that no slices are left over, how many should she order?

Quinn wants to know how many marshmallows he gets in a bowl of cereal. On the 1st day, he counted 6 marshmallows. On the 2nd day, he had 2 times as many marshmallows as he did the day before. The 3rd day, he found half as many marshmallows as he had yesterday. On the 4th day, he counted 2/3 more marshmallows than the day before. How many marshmallows did Quinn have on average?

Mario leaves his house and drives 20 minutes to hike at a nearby park. He spends 1.5 hours at the park and then heads to a nearby store to buy a few groceries. It normally takes 15 minutes to drive from the park to the store, but the drive took twice as long due to traffic. He spends one-third as much time in the store as he spent driving to the store from the park. The drive from the store back to his home took half as long as it took to drive from his house to the park. How many minutes passed between leaving his house and returning home?

Mary and Jane were running for school president position. 40% of students supported Mary and 30% supported Jane. And, the rest were not sure. If the school had 1400 students, how many students were unsure?

Louise went to visit the Philippines. She tried going to her destination using the public transportation. From her hotel, she rode a modern jeepney going to her destination. The first four kilometers cost 14 pesos and an additional 4 pesos for every succeeding kilometer. Returning to her hotel, she rode a traditional jeepney which cost 12 pesos for the first four kilometers, and the additional fare for the succeeding kilometers was half the modern jeepney's succeeding rate. If she paid 26 pesos for the modern jeepney, what was her total fare expense for both jeepney rides?

Clifford needs 2.5 teaspoon of coffee in per cup of coffee he makes. He drinks 2 cups of coffee every day. Each jar of coffee contains about 240 teaspoons of coffee. How long a jar of coffee will last him?

Hyde makes $500 a week working at the mall. On top of that, she earns both a 10% bonus and $100 in commissions every week. She pays $75 a week for health benefits before putting 18% of her weekly earning into a savings account. How much would Hyde have left from two weeks of earnings (excluding the amount in her savings account)?

Theo works for $20 an hour. Each week, he works for 40 hours. He receives biweekly paychecks, so he gets one every other week or typically 2 monthly. Each paycheck, $25 is taken out for health insurance, $78 is taken out for his retirement plan, and $2 is taken out for dental insurance before taxes are deducted. After these amounts are taken out of the paycheck, Theo pays 20% of this amount in taxes, and the rest of the paycheck is his take-home pay. In a typical month, where Theo receives 2 paychecks, how much money will he take home from his work?

Phil is an astronomer on the local news. He wants to do a story on the changes in the weather over the past few years. To begin, he needs to determine the difference between the sum of the highest and lowest temperatures. The highest temperatures he recorded were 3, 16, 57, 64, and 81 degrees Fahrenheit, while the lowest temperatures he recorded were 7, 8, 34, 51, and 70 degrees Fahrenheit. Then he needed to double the difference and divide it by the number of years encompassed in his study to determine the year-over-year temperature change. If his study was done over six years, what was the year-over-year change in temperature?

Bear Lake Chocolate Factory had its grand opening. The candy store sold the following on its first day: 135 pounds of truffles for $3/pound, 132 fudge squares for $2 each, 120 chocolate covered gummy bear bags at $5 each bag, 569 white chocolate pretzels for $3 each, and 68 candy apples for $8 each. How much money did the candy store make on opening day?
Charles needs to fill up his tank since he only has 1 gallon left. If a full tank is 13 gallons and gas is priced at $3.50 a gallon, how much would Charles need to pay to fill up?

Bailey goes to the ice shop with $20. She buys ice cream 1 scoop for $3.50 and a double scoop for $5.50. Natasha was short $3, and asked Bailey to borrow the money. How much money does Bailey have left?
Jill is 5 years old and Jack is 11 years old. At what age would Jack have to turn to be twice as old as Jill?

Tyrone owns a laptop repair shop. This upcoming week he has a lot of laptops to fix. 10 customers dropped off Chromebooks, 17 dropped off Macbooks, and 8 dropped off Lenovos for repair. Tyrone wants to repair an equal amount of laptops each day of the week so they can all be done on time. How many laptops does he need to repair a day?

Sebastian is planning a road trip. He knows that his car's fuel efficiency is 25 miles per gallon. The trip is 500 miles one way, and he plans to return by the same route. Gas costs $3.50 per gallon. He also plans to stay in a hotel for 2 nights, which costs $120 per night. The hotel parking fee is $15 a night. He also needs to budget $30 per day for food at his destination. How much will the entire trip cost?
A motorcyclist maintained a speed of 70 mph in 36 minutes. How many miles did the motorcyclist cover?

Walter has a medical bill of $2000. Each month he pays a higher percentage of money for his bill. During the four months of his payments, he pays 20%, 25%, 30%, and then 50% of his money for his bill in each individual month, respectively. After 4 months, what is his balance?
Howard bought 9 pizzas for a party. Each pizza has 8 slices. His guests ate 6 pizzas. How many slices of pizza are left?
Maddie is taking a walk. She walks 2 miles in an hour. If Connor is 2 times faster than her, what is the distance Connor can walk in three hours.

Company A currently has 60 employees. Due to the economic slowdown in the fourth quarter of the year, the company needs to reduce its workforce by 1/3. However, the following spring, the hiring manager anticipates an economic recovery and plans to increase the staff by 10 percent from the current number. At the end of the year, Company B, which has 3 times as many employees as Company A's employee after the economic recovery, decides to merge with Company A, combining their work forces. How many total employees will there be after the merger?

Laz and Cody are DJs. Laz listened to 5 hours of music a day to prepare for their set. Cody listened to 3 hours of music a day for a week to prepare for their set. How much music in total did they listen to after 7 weeks?

A baker made a batch of cookies and sold them in packs. He sold five packs of chocolate chip cookies, each each pack containing four cookies. He also sold twice as many oatmeal cookie packs as chocolate chip cookie packs, each containing three cookies. If he had 8 chocolate chip cookies and 9 oatmeal cookies left over after selling the packs, how many cookies did he make in total?
Bella is selling fruit juice. The 8oz is sold for 10 cents while the 16oz is sold for 15 cents. If a customer who bought 2 of each gave 1 dollar, how much change does Bella need to give?

A student needs to complete a science project that involves planting seeds. The student decides to plant 3 seeds in each pot. Pots cost $5 each. If the student wants to use exactly 27 seeds, how much will they spend on pots?
Marina bought 3 hot dogs a total of $15. Jose bought twice as many hot dogs as Ben. Jose's total was $30. How much did Ben spend on hot dogs?

George is eating at a restaurant with his family. The restaurant offers soda for $5 for the first glass, then $2 for refills. George orders a Coke and then 4 refills over the course of his meal. How much did George spend on his drinks?

Alex plans to adopt a new cat and needs help planning a budget for this event. The adoption fee is $200, and it includes all the essential veterinary care needed for a kitten, but she also needs to buy other supplies for the cat when she brings it home. The litter boxes cost $30, one package of litter costs $17, a bag of dry food costs $55, and the wet food costs $1.50 per can. Alex will buy 2 litter boxes, 3 packages of litter, one bag of dry food, and 12 cans of wet food. How much money should Alex make sure she has before beginning the process of adopting her new cat?
A baker made 150 cupcakes for a bake sale. If 2/5 of them are chocolate and the rest are vanilla, how many more vanilla cupcakes are there than chocolate cupcakes?

Emily is a cashier. A customer arrives and gives her a $20 bill for items that cost a total of $18.75. She gives the change entirely in quarters. If she accidentally gives the customer one extra, how many quarters did she return as change?

Colin is playing dice with his friend Eoin and needs some help keeping track of his score. He begins with 5 points and wins 6 points in the first round. In the second round, he won twice as many points as he won in the first round. In the third round, he had a fantastic roll and was able to triple his total point count! How many points did Colin end the game with?

Katie and her friends are going on a 10-mile hike. They hike at a pace of 3 miles per hour for the first 6 miles. Then they take a 1-hour lunch break before hiking the last 4 miles at a pace of 2 miles per hour. How long does it take them, in hours, to finish the hike?
Joann's dog gives birth to 12 puppies. 1/4 of them have white fur, 1/2 of them have black fur, and the rest have both black and white fur. How many puppies have both black and white fur?
Louis, Steve, and John compete to see how far they can run. Louis beats Steve by 20 meters, and John runs twice as far as Louis. If Steve ran 15 meters, how many meters did John run?

Taylor lives in a six-bedroom, four-bathroom house. She is looking to paint the inside of her home and wants to figure out how much money she needs to set aside for paint. She estimates she will need two buckets of paint for each bedroom, and she will need twice as many buckets of paint for all the hallways as the total number of buckets used for the bedrooms. The kitchen will need twice as many buckets of paint as the number of buckets for all the bathrooms, and she estimates she will need half a bucket of paint for each bathroom. If a bucket of paint costs $12, how much will it cost Taylor to repaint the inside of her house?

Michael works at a movie cinema and sells tickets for different films. Movie A tickets cost $10, Movie B costs $8, Movie C costs half as much as Movie A, and Movie D costs 50% more than Movie B. Michael sold 10 tickets for Movie A, 5 tickets for movie C, and 10 tickets for movie D. If Michael made $301 in total from selling movie tickets, how many tickets for Movie B did he sell?

A group of students went on an expedition. They found four turtles each of which was 2 pounds. They also saw two rabbits with their combined weight equaling half that of one turtle. Find the weight of all the animals that they discovered.
Milly is eating a pie. She eats 4 slices and eats 2 times as much the next day. How many total slices of pie did Milly eat?
Janet wants to listen to 20 music albums by the end of the week. If she just finished her twelfth album and today is Thursday, how many albums per day would she have to listen to by Saturday?

There is four students in the class room waiting for the class to start. In the next couple minutes three more students enter the class room, but one student leaves from the four that were already there. Soon after 3 times the amount of the initial students in the class enter and the bell rings to start class. How many students are in the classroom.?

Lily is planning a trip to Japan with their boyfriend. They plan to spend $2400 on airfare, $800 on lodging, and $1,000 on food and excursions. They also plan to purchase travel insurance for 10% of the total trip cost. Their partner offers to pay ¾ of the costs, so they are only responsible for the remainder, which they aim to pay in 5 monthly installments. Their weekly expenses are $100. They earn on average $750 a month. How much money, in dollars, will they have left over after paying their bills and trip expenses for the month?
Bob has 20 apples. He eats 40% of them and then sells the remaining apples at $4 each. John has 18 apples. He sells half of them at $6 each. What is the difference between Bob's and John's earnings?

John owns a cabin that he allows people to rent for $100 per day. Every month, his mortgage on the cabin costs him $2000. If he booked his cabin for 25 days in a month, how much profit did he make during the month?

A company bought 200 units of product A at $50 each. The company bought 150 units of product B at $30 each. The company had to pay a fixed operation fee of $2,000. How much did the company pay altogether?

Morgan bought 6 pots of flowers. Each pot yields 2 seeds. If Morgan continues to water the plants, every plant will yield 2 more seeds than the day before. How many seeds in total will Morgan get at the end of two days?

Shaggy is buying ingredients so he can prepare a particularly large sandwich. The sandwich has 6 identical layers. Each layer has 2 slices of tomato, 4 leaves of lettuce, 2 slices of cheese, and 6 slices of roast beef. Each slice of tomato and leaf of lettuce costs 25 cents, each slice of cheese costs 75 cents, and each slice of roast beef costs 50 cents. He also needs 2 slices of bread for the sandwich, which, in total, will cost 20 cents. How much (in cents) will Shaggy need to spend on ingredients to create the sandwich?

Bob has $20 and Mary has $60 more than Bob. Now Bob and Mary put all their money together and split the entire fund evenly. Then Bob gives 20% of his share to Mary. How much does Mary have in the end?
Gino bought 8 shirts for $100, he got a 25% discount. How much in dollars did he spend?

At an elementary school, each class of students is challenged to read twice as many books as the year before. For example, in kindergarten, students are encouraged to read 20 books either independently or with an adult. In first grade, students are encouraged to read 40 books during the academic year. If this amount doubles each school year, and the students adhere to the guidelines, how many books will each student have read by the end of elementary school (elementary school concludes after fifth grade)?

Julian is going on a trip. His flight is $350. He is spending twice that on his hotel. He is going to spend half the amount of his flight on food. He will spend 1/4 of the amount on his flight and food combined on transportation while he is there. The cost of visiting museums and shows while he is on vacation is twice the amount he will spend on transportation. He is going to spend $100.25 on souvenirs. He had budgeted $2000 for his trip. How much will he have left?
Sandra opened her piggy bank. She was able to save 100 quarters and 10 half dollars. However, this was not enough to buy her favorite toy so her mother gave her $10. How much does the toy cost?

Barbara spelunks in her free time to collect beautiful crystals and geodes. Her trip to the Yosemite Caverns yielded 3 crystals that were 8, 14, and 6 inches in length respectively. During the following week, she went to Reed Flute Cave and picked up 2 more crystals that were each half as long as the first and second crystals found in the Yosemite Caverns. Her primary display shelf is 54 inches long and her 4 display cases are each a third as long as her display shelf. If she arranges the crystals length-wise for display, how many inches of display room are left for future crystals?

There were 24000 volunteers in a clinical vaccination trial and the ratio of those given the vaccine to those given the placebo is 5:3. How many more volunteers were given the vaccine than the placebo?

Action Motors has two plants that produce motor scooters. The first plant operates 16 hours per day, 5 days a week. It produces 10 scooters per hour. The second plant operates 8 hours per day, 7 days a week. It produces 20 scooters per hour. Action Motors plans to open a third plant so it can produce a total of 2400 scooters per day. This plant will operate 10 hours per day, 6 days a week. To meet the overall goal of 2400 scooters per week, how many scooters must the third plant produce per hour?

Mikal wants to bake brownies for the kids and the teachers in his class. The brownie pan that he has will make 12 brownies. There are 32 kids and 2 teachers in his class. How many times will Mikal need to bake brownies in his pan to have enough for everyone in the class to get one brownie?
The man with the world's longest toenails has been growing them for 16 years. If his toenails grow at a rate of .75 inches per month, how many feet long are his toenails currently?

A cake shop sells three flavors of cakes: vanilla, strawberry, and chocolate. A piece of vanilla cake is sold for $10. A piece of strawberry cake is sold for $2 less than a piece of vanilla cake. A piece of chocolate cake is sold for twice as much as a piece of strawberry cake. Mary buys 3 pieces of vanilla cake, 4 pieces of strawberry cake, and 5 pieces of chocolate cake. Mary also buys a small box for each piece of cake, and each cake box is sold for $0.50. How much in total does Mary spend?

In a park, there are 8 ponds with a total of 44 fish across all ponds. After a disease spreads between the fish, 4 of them die. If the average amount of fish in each pond last year was 7 fish per pond, by how many fish has the average dropped?
John is 3 times as old as Jacob was 4 years ago. Jacob is 12 years old now. How old is John?
John gets 3 orders of 9-piece chicken nuggets from a fast-food restaurant. He gives 5 to his girlfriend and splits the rest with his best friend. How many chicken nuggets is John left with?

Ellis is very talented on the guitar and has decided to prepare a 30-minute music performance for her friends. She plans to start with a 3-minute introduction, then play her country's National Anthem which takes 2 minutes. She then plans to perform three songs that each take 6 minutes to play. If she wants to finish the performance with an improvisational Jazz song that she can set to any length of time, how much time does she have for her Jazz song if she wants to finish the performance on time?

It takes train #1 2 hours to go 200 miles from city A to city B. Train #2 travels 66 miles from city C to city B in 1 hour. Train #3 departs from city C to city A, and it takes 3 hours to travel the 180 miles. Train #4 goes 400 miles from city A to city D in 8 hours. What is the average miles per hour for all four trains?

Tyriq is making pizza dough for his restaurant. Every day, he needs to knead 14 lbs of dough for his restaurant. It takes him 30 minutes for him to knead one lb of dough. How much time, in hours, does Tyriq spend kneading dough over the course of 5 work days?

Elisa was taking her family to New York for the day. The family had $350 to spend on Elisa, her wife, and their two children. They had to purchase train tickets, which are $20 roundtrip for adults and $10 roundtrip for children, four $40 tickets for the theatre, and $60 per restaurant at two different restaurants. After totaling up the cost, how much money does Elisa’s family have left to spend?
Sarah ate three cookies and Robert ate twice as many as Sarah. If each cookies costed 5 dollars, how much more money did Robert spend compared to Sarah.

A group of students is organizing a reading marathon to raise funds for their school library. Each student is sponsored for $5 for every 10 pages they read. If a student reads 150 pages, how much money, in dollars, will they raise for the library?

Jewel began working on a painting that requires 25 hours to complete. On the first day, she painted for 8% of the total time. On the second day, she painted for 4% more time than she did on the first day. She took the third day off. If she has to complete the work in 2 weeks, how many hours does she have to paint every day to distribute her remaining working hours equally over the following days to meet the deadline?
Carla wants to make a quilt that contains 100 quilt blocks. If the quilt will be square, how many quilt blocks will be in each row?

Winston, Kara, Chelsea, Velma, and Skip met for a cookie swap. Each friend brought a batch of cookies which was divided evenly among the five of them. Winston brought half as many cookies as Kara. Velma brought 5 more cookies than Skip. Skip brought three times as many cookies as Chelsea. Winston brought as many cookies as Skip and Chelsea combined. If Chelsea brought 5 cookies, how many cookies did she end up with after the swap, and after her sister took 7 cookies off her plate?

4 friends are going on a road trip. Their names are Alex, Bethany, Carlos, and Drew. They drive at a rate of 65, 75, 60, and 50 mph, respectively. Alex drives for 2 hours, Bethany for 4, and Carlos and Drew each drive for 3 hours. They are using a car with a fuel efficiency of 20 miles per gallon of gas. If, along their route, gas costs $3 per gallon, how much money (in dollars) will they need to spend on gas? Assume they begin their journey at a gas station with an empty tank of gas.
If Gary had thirteen nickels, how many cents would he be away from a dollar?

Bailey wants to rent a kayak for 3 people. Kayak rentals are $14/hour for each single-person kayak, and a double-person kayak is $24/hour. Bailey decided to get a single-person and a double-person kayak. One of Bailey's friends will need to leave early, so they will only rent the single-person kayak for one hour, and they will use the double-person kayak for one hour and 45 minutes. He wants to leave a 25% tip. How much will Bailey spend on kayaking, including the tip?

At the craft store Michael's, Jose bought a bag of blue, red and clear gemstones. The bag contained 120 gemstones, 60% of the gemstones were red, and 30 of them were clear. How many blue gem stones were in the bag?

Jacob has 24 marbles and he wants to share them equally with his 3 friends. After sharing the marbles, Jacob finds 6 more marbles. How many marbles will each friend get if Jacob decides to share the new marbles equally among his friends as well?

Gary started a food truck with his own money. He originally invested $27200 into the truck. Every week that it operates, he brings in $1200, but he spends a third of that on supplies. If he has been open for six weeks, how many more weeks will it take him to make a profit that equals his original investment?

In the next 30 days, the weather forecast shows that 2/5 of the days will be sunny, 1/10 will be cloudy, 1/6 will be rainy, and 1/5 will be windy. The weather for the remaining days is unpredictable. How many days have unpredictable weather?

Kim uses the bus to go from her house do different places. She travels 25 miles to get from her home to school and after school, she travels 2 times more miles than her first stop and studies at the library. After studying at the library, she gets on the bus again and goes home. The distance from the library and her home is 1/2 as long as the distance from the school to the library. How many miles does Kim travel in total?
I need 5 pound of wheat to make 2 large pizzas. Every day I make 8 pizzas. How many pounds of wheat I need in a week (a week consists of 7 days)?

Beth is moving and she needs 34 boxes based on her calculations. Boxes are on sale for $5 each. After she is done with moving, Beth sells all the boxes to a neighbor for $50. After recouping the money from the neighbor, what was the net cost of the boxes?
In a senior class of 1,200, the percentage of AP students is 10%. 90% of the AP students attend college. Calculate the number of AP students who do not go on to college.

Esteban is waiting in line at the bank. Customers in the line can make a withdrawal, make a deposit, or open a new account. Making a withdrawal or deposit takes a customer thirty seconds, but opening an account is a lengthy process that takes four minutes. Six people ahead of Esteban are making withdrawals, and eight are making deposits. If it took nineteen minutes to get to the front of the line, how many people had to have been opening a new account?

Kevin went to the mall with some friends. He had $50 to spent. First they went to a clothing store where Kevin spent $30 on some new shirts. Then they grabbed some pizza for lunch where Kevin buys 2 slices of pizza for $2.50 each. Now he wants to buy some toys. How much money does Kevin have left to spend on toys?

A large sandwich give 6 portions and a small gives 4 portions. Joe bought 4 large sandwiches and 6 small sandwhiches. He wants to eat 5 portions. Paul want to eat 3 portions. George wants to eat 2 more pieces than Paul. Greg wants to eat twice as many as Paul. Hilda, Fred, and Ginnie will eat 2 pieces. How many portions will remain?

John has a digital marketing business and writes and publishes blog articles and social media posts for his clients. When he started using generative AI to help create content, he could write, publish, and promote an article in 1 hour. Each client needs 4 articles a week. John has 8 hours in a work day and he does writing and publishing on Mondays and Tuesdays. How many clients can John serve on Mondays and Tuesdays?

Sarah spends $47 on piano lessons per session. She has 3 lessons per month during June, July, and August. She has 4 lessons per month during the other remaining 9 months. How much does Sarah spend in total for piano lessons per year?

Gerry's cats, Tina and Lana, eat a diet of wet food and dry food. Tina eats 3 cups of dry and 8 cans of wet food weekly. Lana eats 4 cups of dry food and 6 cans of wet food weekly. Each cup of dry food costs $0.50, and each can of wet food costs $0.75. How much money does Gerry spend on cat food for Tina and Lana in a week?

Maria hired three people (Alan, Bettina, and Carlos) to remodel her kitchen. The job required a total of 100 hours of work. Alan and Bettina each completed 30% of the work while Carlos completed 40%. Based on their skill levels, Alan and Carlos were each paid $10 per hour, while Bettina was paid $20 per hour. What was the average hourly wage paid by Maria to complete the 100 hours of work?

Jayme's 8th grade microeconomics class uses "micro bucks" in their token economy. On Monday, Jayme earned 14 micro bucks. On Tuesday Jayme earned 1/2 as many micro bucks than the day before. On Wednesday, Jayme was sick and did not attend school. On Thursday, Jayme earned 13 micro bucks. On Friday, Jayme earned 12 micro bucks plus 3 micro bucks as a bonus. How many micro bucks did Jayme earn for the week?

Olga is a nice lady in Fort Worth who loves helping people out. Her neighbor Mary called her from jail, asking for help coming up with bail money. Mary claims her bail amount is $1,400 but she only has a quarter of the money she needs. Olga doubts she’s getting paid back if she helps out so she takes up a collection among 7 neighbors, herself included, because Mary’s grass is getting long and needs cutting. How much is each neighbor paying to bail Mary out of jail so she can get her grass cut?

There are 120 students at Miller Middle School. The student council recently took a survey about their favorite flavor of ice cream. The survey found that 30% of the students liked chocolate, 20% of the students liked vanilla, and 10% of the students liked strawberry. The rest of the students said they didn't like ice cream. Of those students who don't like ice cream, 50% said they loved cake. Of those students who said they loved cake, 50% said chocolate cake was their favorite. How many students said chocolate cake was their favorite?

Alan offers lawn mowing and plant watering services for his neighbors. He charges $1 per square foot of lawn he mows and $20 for every 50 plants he waters. On Saturday, Alan mowed a 15 feet x 10 feet lawn and watered 250 plants. If Alan wants to save up $700 by the end of the weekend and plans on mowing a 25 feet x 14 feet lawn on Sunday, how many plants should he water on Sunday?

Amy is 3 years old now. Her brother Jimmy is 3 years older than Amy. Amy and Jimmy's father is 30 years older than Jimmy. Amy and Jimmy's mother is 5 years younger than their father. How old is Amy and Jimmy's mother?

Gloria works as a video editor and gets paid $25 an hour. The assets she needs for each project cost $40. The editing software also has a one-time service fee of $15. If she completes three different projects and works 20 hours overall, how much money does she make?

Nelson enjoys working puzzles. On average, he solves a 1000 piece puzzle in 25 hours. Nelson can solve a 500 piece puzzle in 60% quicker than it takes to solve a 1000 piece puzzle. To solve a 200 piece puzzle, it only takes 20% of the time it takes to solve a 500 piece puzzle. During Spring Break, Nelson solved a 1000 piece puzzle, three 500 piece puzzles, and six 200 piece puzzles. How many hours did Nelson spend solving puzzles?

Mark is a Customer Service Agent at XYZ company. He just had his annual review, he got a 4% increase in his hourly rate. His hourly rate before the increase was $30/hour. He got a $7500 bonus for good performance. Assuming he works forty hours a week and 52 weeks a year, what is his annual salary plus bonus?

Sam sells different pastries at his bakery. At the end of the week, he wanted to find his total profit. Each pastry costs him $3 to make, but he sells them for different prices. He sells muffins for $5, donuts for $4, and turnovers for $6. Sam finds that over the course of a week 100 muffins were sold; he also finds that he sold 20 fewer than twice as many muffins as donuts, and half of that number in turnovers. What is his total profit from turnovers for the week?

Jessica is 7 years older than her brother, Charles. Charles is half as old as Matt is. Matt's age is the sum of Phil and Lill's age, who are twins. If Phil is 13, what is the average age between the 5 people?

Yusuf receives $100 for his birthday and donates half of it to charity. He invites his friends to match his donation. Samer triples Yusef's donation, and Tom gives $75 less than Samer. How much money would Zara need to donate to help them reach a $700 donation?

Ms. Crabapple has a bag of jelly beans that she is going to divide equally among all of her 32 students who complete their homework every day over the course of a week. The bag has 384 jellybeans in it. Unfortunately, many of Ms. Crabapple's students have a poorly developed work ethic, and only half of them complete all of the required homework. How many jelly beans will each of the eligible students receive?

Jim is a maintenance worker at a pool. The pool has 2000 liters of water. Every time a child jumps in the pool, they cause 200 mL of water to splash out. When an adult jumps in, they cause 400 mL of water to splash out. Jim has to get everyone out of the pool, clean, and refill it when 1/5 of the water has been splashed out. 20 kids and 60 adults jumped in the pool. How many more kids than adults would be able to jump in the pool before Jim has to refill it?

The local factory has 100,000 employees. In each of the five rounds, employees are selected to use VTO (voluntary time off) at their location. In the first round, 10% get to take time off. For each round, 10% of the remaining employees will be allowed to use VTO. How many employees will be allowed to use VTO in total?

Mrs. Jones class likes to play "speed calculation." Susan was given the number 24. She must complete the following steps: 1. Add 1 more to the number. 2. Divide the new number by 5. 3. Multiply the new number by 10. 4. Divide the new number by 2. 5. Add 5 more to the number. 6. Divide the new number by 3. 7. Add eleven more. 8. Divide by 3. What is the new number?
Megan is eating snacks. She eats 8 cookies and twice the amount of biscuits. If Megan wants to eat half of the total snacks she's eating right now, how many snacks should she eat?

Allison is appraising a gem she's planning to sell. The initial value of a gem is based on its type. Then, the value is modified based on the clarity of the material, its overall size, and how well-cut it is (measured in the number of faces). Allison's gem is a diamond, which means its initial value is $200. The clarity of the material is low, which reduces the price by $25. The size is quite large, which multiplies the final price by 7. Allison had a jeweler refine the gem, and they cut it such that it now has 9 faces, which adds $80 to the base value. Modifications to gem value are calculated in reverse order of operations, that is, subtraction and addition first, then multiplication and division. Allison sells the gem at a market at full price, but the market charges her a fee of $45 to list her item. How much money does Allison make from selling the gem?
Each apple cost $6. Each banana costs $3. How much money will I spend if I buy 3 apples and 5 bananas?

Pascha is taking a road trip. The first stop was 40 miles away. That was the first day. The second day was twice as long. The third day he traveled a third of the distance of the first two days combined. The fourth day he traveled 50 miles. The fifth day he traveled 10 miles farther than the previous. The sixth day he traveled half the distance of the fifth day. If gas is $3.00 a gallon, and he gets 30 miles a gallon, how much was the total fuel cost?
Derek was buying equipment for his baseball team. He needed 15 gloves and 15 hats. He spent $450. If gloves cost $20, how much does a hat cost?
Phil bought 3 packs of blueberries and three times as many packs of strawberries. How many packs of both berries combined did Phil buy?

Amy, Belinda, and Casey work together at The Fashion Boutique. Amy makes $400 per week. Belinda makes 20% more than Amy, and Casey makes $20 more per week than Belinda. How much more per week does Casey make than Amy?

Phish recently played a show with a Tweezer jam that was 14 minutes longer than the Chalk Dust Torture jam. The Chalk Dust Torture jam was twice as long as the Slave to the Traffic Light jam, which was 8 minutes long. How long was the Tweezer jam?

Gabriela has $65.00 and is shopping for groceries so that her grandmother can make her favorite kale soup. She needs heavy cream, kale, cauliflower, and meat (bacon and sausage). Gabriella spends 40% of her money on the meat. She spends $5.00 less than one-third of the remaining money on heavy cream. Cauliflower costs three-fourth of the price of the heavy cream and the kale costs $2.00 less than the cauliflower. As Gabriela leaves the store, she spends one-third of her remaining money on her grandmother's favorite Girl Scout Cookies. How much money, in dollars, does Gabriela spend on Girl Scout cookies?

Karen types at a rate of 50 words per minute. She must submit a 10000-word essay in the next 4 hours. Assuming she types nonstop the whole time, how much time in minutes will she have remaining when she submits?

A painter needs to paint 3 houses. The first house requires 14 gallons of paint, the second house requires twice as much paint as the first, and the third house needs half as much paint as the second house. If one gallon of paint costs $35 and the painter gets a bulk discount of 10% for purchases over 30 gallons, how much will the paint cost in total?

Rohan is walking home. He walks at a rate of 1.5 miles per hour. He needs to buy some milk, so he first walks 2.5 miles to a convenience store, then walks .5 more miles to get back home. There are several crosswalks along the way where he has to wait briefly for cars to pass before crossing the street. As a result, every street he needs to cross adds half a minute to his journey. If it ends up taking Rohan 123 minutes to get back, how many streets must he have crossed?

Harriet is carrying a giant bucket of apples up the hill. She starts with 72 apples but loses half of them when she trips and falls. She is able to regain 9 apples when she finds an apple tree halfway up. When she gets to the top, she divides the apples among the five friends waiting there for her. How many apples did each friend receive?

Sara looks for the TV remote every night for 10 minutes, and then she complains for 4 minutes after she finds it. How many minutes would Sara save each week if she could avoid misplacing the TV remote?

Larry went to the pet store to buy fish for his new aquarium. He bought 28 fish, 4 of which were guppies. 1/3 of the rest of them were betta fish, and the rest were goldfish. Unfortunately, 3 gold fishes died by the end of the day. He spent $2 on each guppy, $4 on each betta fish, and $1 on each goldfish. How much did he spend on the fish in total, excluding the 3 goldfish that died?

Emerson's living room is 200 square feet. He has several pieces of furniture in the room: a chair, which is 2 feet long and 3 feet deep; a table, which is 5 feet long and 2.5 feet deep; an entertainment center, which is 5 feet long and 1.5 feet deep; and a pair of bookshelves, which are 3 feet long and 1.5 feet deep each. Emerson wants to add a couch to the living room, which is 6 feet long and 2 feet deep. How much open floor space will Emerson's living room have after he adds the couch?

Jack is driving 75 miles to Salem then 15 miles to Albany at an average speed of 45 mph. Emily is driving directly to Albany at an average speed of 45 mph. When must jack leave in order to reach Albany at 8 o'clock?
Petunia has 18 garden plots to grow flowers. If each type of flower she wants to grow costs $14, how many plots will be empty if she only has $100?

Franz wants to fill a container with 5 gallons of water. He only has a measuring glass with a maximum capacity of 8 cups and a sink to fill it. 1 gallon is equivalent to 16 cups, and it takes him 4 seconds to fill up the measuring glass. How much total time, in seconds, does Franz spend filling up the measuring glass?

Anji is selling different kinds of pies: peach, apple, and blueberry. She has 5 peach pies; twice as many apple pies than peach pies, and twice as many blueberry pies as apple pies. How many total pies does Anji have to sell?

The original price of a dress was $100. Macy's Store was selling it with a 25% discount. Gina bought the dress. She also got another discount and so she paid one-fifth less than the discounted price. She then sold the dress to her friend and she asked for a price that is 60% more than what she paid for it. What was her profit?

Jonas competes in bodybuilding competitions and needs to check his workout routine. He benches 3 sets of 15 reps with 110 lbs on the 90 lb bar. After his bench press sets, he does 1 set of 8 reps with a 50 lb curl bar. By the end of his workout, how many pounds will he have lifted in total?

There are five hungry rabbits in a garden where there are 32 carrots available to eat. Two rabbits are hungry and each eats 6 carrots until each is full, but the other 3 rabbits are only half as hungry and each eats only half as much. How many carrots remain in the garden after the rabbits are done eating?
Johan the spider catches flies at a rate of 3 flies per minute. If he catches flies for 8 hours straight, how many flies will he have caught at the end of the day?

The local professional baseball team plays 100 games a season. Over the last 3 seasons they won 42 games, 61 games and 83 games, respectively. What is the average winning percentage of the baseball team over 3 seasons?
The school library has 120 books. The librarian bought 30 new books. The students borrowed twice as many books as the librarian bought. How many books are left in the library?

Juan is completing a woodworking project of 12 chalkboards. For each chalkboard, there are eight 90 degree joints and each joint will require two screws. Screws come in boxes of 50. How many boxes will Juan need to complete the woodworking project?

Ann buys 2 small pizzas (each with 6 pieces) and 2 large pizzas (each with 8 pieces) for her friend. Ann can eat 10 pieces and her friend can eat 5 more pieces than Ann. How many pieces of pizza will be left over?

Zoey got an ant farm for her birthday. She's watching to see how many more ants populate in the colony. Her ant farm has 50 starter ants. Every 5 days, her ant colony doubles in size. Every 10 days, 1/4 of the total colony dies. How many more ants does Zoey have on the 25th day than the first day?

Albert gets paid $15 an hour. He gets time and a half if he works over forty hours a week. Last week, he worked 48 hours. He plans to do this two weeks in a row. How much money will he be paid in overtime for those two weeks?
Citra buys 4 lbs of ground beef at $5.00/lb and 2 lbs of chicken breast at $4.00/lb. How much money did Citra spend at the store?

John starts to farm. He owns 3 acres of land, where each acre can produce 8 pounds of apples, 10 pounds of pears, and 12 pounds of oranges every month. Apples, pears, and oranges are sold at $8, $6, $4 per pound, respectively. How much will John earn within two months?

Riley is saving for a new video game that costs $60. She has already saved $15. Her mom gives her $5 to contribute to her goal. She has a job that pays $10 per hour. How many hours will she have to work to get the rest of the money she needs?
John is half as old as Maria, who is four times as old as Darien. If John is 10, how old will Darien be in five years?
Sarah's age is half of her sister Mary's age. Their father is 42 years older than Mary and father's current age is 48 years. What is Sarah's age?
A population of 6 rabbits was observed to double every year. How many rabbits would be there after 7 years following this trend?

Rama planted 10 blueberry plants. Matthew planted 35 more plants than Rama and thrice as many as Sally. Each plant produces about 2 pounds of blueberries and they are sold at $2 per pound. What is their combined earning?

A goblin named Gordon is collecting gems to sell at the market. If Gordon collects 12 gems worth $16 each, and the market only buys merchandise at 50% of its value, how much money will Gordon gain by selling his findings?
Linda was asked to make a digital copy of a four-page contract with 750 words on each page. If Linda could type 50 words per minute, how long would it take her to type half the number of pages?

The town is buying equipment for a volleyball court. Each ball costs $13 and a net costs $46. If they need 8 balls and one net, and everything in the state has 8% sales tax, how much will it cost to buy the needed equipment?

Alejandro is helping plan a fundraising event for his school's charity club. He wants to sell homemade cookies and lemonade. He calculates that each cookie will cost $0.50 to make, and each cup of lemonade will cost $0.25 to make. He plans to sell the cookies for $1 each and the lemonade for $0.75 per cup. Alejandro decides to sell 50 cookies and 32 cups of lemonade. After factoring in the cost of ingredients and the revenue earned from the sale of cookies and lemonade, how much will he profit, the difference between revenue and cost?

Kym decided to clean out her closet and donate some articles of clothing to charity. In her closet, Kym only has sweaters, jeans, shirts and athletic pants. Kym currently has 20 sweaters and will donate 2/5 of them. She has 15 pair of jeans and will donate 20% of them. Kym has 18 shirts and will donate 50% of them. She has 20 pair of athletic pants and will donate 5 less than 30% of the athletic pants. How many articles of clothing does Kym have left in her closet after she donates some clothing to charity?
A train car has 5 rows of 3 seats. 2/3 of the seats are occupied. Anyone not sitting in a seat is standing. If there are 17 people in that particular train car, how many are standing?

The weather in Pittsburgh varies during March. On March 1, the temperature is 45 degrees. On March 2, the temperature is 5 degrees warmer than that. On March 3, the temperature suddenly drops 30 degrees. On March 4, the temperature goes up by 10 degrees. On March 5, the temperature suddenly drops 20 degrees. On March 6, the temperature suddenly rises 40 degrees. On March 7, the temperature remains the same as on March 6. What is the difference in temperature between March 7 and March 1?

Andy is walking in a Fourth of July parade throwing out candy. He has Tootsie Rolls and Lollipops, and he wants to make sure he has enough of both for the entire parade. He throws out two handfuls of each candy for every minute of the parade, and these handfuls have 16 pieces of candy in them. A bag of Tootsie Rolls comes with 112 pieces, and a bag of lollipops comes with 56 pieces. If the parade is 42 minutes long, how many more bags of lollipops does he need to buy than bags of Tootsie Rolls?

Kim went to climb Mt. Fuji in Japan. She started from the fifth station and worked her way up to the summit, which is in the tenth station. It took her one hour to reach each station except for the final station where she needed an additional hour. If the descent takes half the total hour as the ascend, how long did it take for her to finish?

Marian was planning a scrapbook and wanted to know how many picture slots she needed. Her friend Tom took 16 pictures, another friend James took four more than twice as many pictures as Tom, and Marian took 4 fewer than Tom. How many picture slots does Marian need for all three sets of pictures?

Mary fundraised $200. Jenny fundraised $600 more than Mary but half of Sally. Tommy fundraised $100 more than three-fourths of Sally's. How much must Remmy fundraise if they donate $50 to each of the 90 children in the foster care home?

Alan eats 600 calories for breakfast and his calories for lunch are 50% more than breakfast. He also eats three snacks which average to 50 calories per snack and two glasses of milk that come out to 60 calories per glass. If Alan wants to stay under 2400 calories for the day, what's the maximum amount of calories he can have for dinner?

Mr. Gordon has 14 boys in his first period class which is twice the number of girls in class. Two of the girls in class have blonde hair and the rest have brown hair. How many girls with brown hair are in his class?

Julia is selling tickets to her show. General admission costs $40, balcony seats cost $70 and VIP tickets cost $100. She sold 24 general admission tickets, 9 balcony seat tickets, and 7 VIP tickets. Drinks were also being sold for $8 each. Half the people who bought tickets showed up for the show, and they all bought one drink each. How much money, in dollars, did Julia make in total?

Usain Bolt runs 190 meters in 19 seconds while Bob runs 50 meters in 10 seconds. If they start at the same time, how far would Bob be from the starting line, in meters, when Usain Bolt finishes a 250-meter run?

Dave is doing a school project to calculate how many buses his school district would need if every student rode the bus. He knows that each bus has 24 rows that seat 2 students each. He also knows there are 40,000 students in his school district. How many buses would be needed if 3/4 of the students in the district rode the bus to school?

Janet and Rosalia are making anklets to sell at the craft fair. Each anklet has 10 trinkets. Janet has 60 gold trinkets and 20 fewer silver trinkets. Rosalia has 40 bronze trinkets and half as many diamond trinkets as bronze trinkets. How many anklets can Rosalia and Janet make?

Skylar is making bracelets for her family. She wants to make one for each family member which is 6 people. Each bracelet will have 8 red beads, twice as many blue beads as red beads, and half as many green beads as red beads. How many beads will she use in all?

Robin has a free-range chicken farm. Each chicken coop houses 8 chickens, and she has 42 chicken coops. Of her total number of chickens, 1/6th are white with brown spots. Unfortunately for our dear Robin, 29 of her white chickens with brown spots were taken by the local pack of foxes. How many white chickens with brown spots are left after the theft?

Patricia volunteers to bake 400 cookies for her church picnic. She bakes twice as many chocolate chips cookies as sugar cookies, and she bakes 50 more snickerdoodle cookies than the amount of sugar cookies. If she baked 75 sugar cookies, how many more cookies does she need to bake?

Mary plans to do some shopping this weekend. She would like to buy 3 pairs of pants that cost $10 each pair, 5 pairs of shoes that cost $12 each pair, 3 tops that cost $5 each, 3 shorts that cost $4 each, 3 hats that cost $8 each, 3 pairs of sunglasses that cost $9 each, and 2 pairs of socks that cost $6 each. How much is the total budget that Mary should make for the weekend shopping?

At the Downtown Discount Store, Andrea purchases two food items costing $2 and $3. She also purchases several non-food items. Her total cost (before tax) is $45. Non-food items are taxed at a 5% rate. Food items are not taxed. What is Andrea's total bill after tax is included?

Harry enters a hotdog eating contest. At the end of the contest, Harry managed to eat 40 hotdogs. One of his opponents, Kyle, ate double what Tony ate and Tony ate 10 hotdogs. Jose ate half of what Sarah ate. Sarah, the reigning hotdog-eating champion ate double what Tony ate, plus what Harry ate. How many more hotdogs were eaten by Harry and Sarah than the rest of the contestants?

Perry is doing his homework for the week. He has 15 questions left to do. He can finish 2 questions per hour and spends 4 hours on his homework. He'll also be getting double what he didn't finish today for tomorrow's work. At his current pace, how many questions will Perry have to complete tomorrow?
Someone spilled all the plastic cups at a party. If, after reorganizing them into stacks, there are 2 stacks of 15 cups and 3 stacks of 8 cups, how many cups were spilled?

The teacher has a total of 300 pieces of candy which are divided equally amongst 25 students. If Bob, one of the students, decides to give 7 of his candies to anther student next to him, how many candies will bob have left?

Johnny and Tommy are having dinner at a restaurant. It's Tommy's turn to pay but Johnny offers to pay the tip. If the check's total is $269.50 and Johnny puts $30.51 down, how much more does Johnny need to tip 18% of the bill?

Alejandro and Stacy both measured how much rainwater they had outside of their houses. Alejandro measured 2 inches of rain and Stacy measured 3 times as much rain as Alejandro. How much more rain did Stacy have compared to Alejandro?

Bob is looking for a new job. He plans to apply for quantitative researcher and machine learning engineer positions. He plans to submit five applications for each position every day. How many job applications will Bob submit within one week?

Riley Elementary is planning a pizza party for 5th grade graduation. Class A has 22 students. Class B has 25 students. Class C has 26 students. Class D has 28 students. If each student gets two slices of pizza, then how many pizza slices are needed?

Dwayne would like to start a collection of coins. He already has 50 quarters, he has double the number of pennies that he does quarters, and he has 1/2 the number of nickels as he does quarters. Mary has offered to give her coins to Dwayne. She has four times as many quarters as Dwayne, double the number of nickels as Dwayne, and five times the number of pennies as Dwayne. She also has twice the number of dimes that she does the number of quarters. If Mary gives all her coins to Dwayne, how many coins (not money or the value of the coins) will he have?

Bebe can take 6 phone calls an hour and type 10 emails an hour. Jay can take 3 phone calls an hour and also write 3 emails an hour. If Bebe spends half of her shift writing emails and half taking calls, how many calls do Bebe and Jay take in an 8-hour workday?
Phil can pay $5000 for a car today. If he waits a year, the car will cost 10% more than today’s price. If Phil waits for a year, how much does he pay for the car?

Jen and Danny have 6 chickens. There are two brown chickens, three yellow chickens, and one white chicken. Brown chickens lay an egg every day, yellow chickens lay an egg once a week, and white chickens lay an egg three times a week. Jen and Danny eat two eggs a day. How many are left over for them to sell at the end of the week?
Luigi is collecting coins and stars in a game. Each coin is worth 2 points, and each star is worth 10 points. If he finishes a level with 12 coins and 16 stars, what is his point total?

Let's say Howard and Jessica are going to host a movie night for their friends. Jessica buys eight bags of popcorn for $4 a piece, and Howard gets five large pizzas for $15 apiece. They decide they are also going to buy twelve chocolate shakes for $1 a piece and 3 king-sized bags of candy for $20 per bag. Finally, they chose to rent 3 movies to watch for the night, with each movie rental costing $5. What is the total they spent on the movie night?

Alice was in Wonderland where she saw a cookie store and decided to buy raspberry and strawberry cookies. Each raspberry cookie is $0.25, and each strawberry costs $1.50. If she buys 24 raspberry cookies and 8 strawberry cookies, how much does she spend in total?

Wanda wants to dress up as a fairy for Halloween, and she has a budget of $50 to buy her costume which includes a dress, gloves, socks, and fairy shoes. If she spends $24 for her dress, and one third as much for socks and gloves combined, how many dollars does she have remaining to buy fairy shoes?

Gabriel is studying groups of wild cats for a research project. On his first day, he saw 8 adult cats and ¼ as many cubs. On his second day, he saw 4 new cubs and twice as many new adult cats. On his third day, he saw as many new cubs as he did first day and half as many new adult cats as first day. How many cats and cubs did he see in total?

Soren is planning a pizza party for his friends. He wants to order pizza from a local pizzeria. Each pizza has 9 slices. If he has 27 friends coming to the party, and each friend has 3 slices each, how many pizzas does Soren need to order?

Ian got a new video game for his birthday. He can't wait to play it all day on Saturday. He woke up at 9:00 a.m. and was getting ready to play when, unfortunately, his mom said he could only play if he finished his chores. Ian's chores include cleaning his room, walking the dog, and putting away the dishes. He took 1 hour to clean his room, 1 hour and 45 minutes to walk the dog, and 15 minutes to put away the dishes. If Ian has to have dinner at 5:00 p.m., how many hours does he get to play his game after completing all of his chores?

A library has a collection of 100 fantasy novels arranged in a bookcase. 10 people borrow 4 books each from the shelf on a particular day, and 20 more books are borrowed from the shelf on the second day. How many books are remaining on the shelf after the second day?

A Boeing 767 flies at an average speed of 530 miles per hour and is flying a route with a single layover in between the start and its destination. The first leg of the trip is 1060 miles, and the second is 1325 miles. The layover lasts for 1.5 hours. How long is the entire trip?

This years earning reports are in and December was the highest earning month with $5000 in sales. November earned half the amount as December, but $500 more than October. September, August, and July all earned $100 more than October. June had $1000 less than the three months after it. May and April earned a quarter the amount of June. If March, February, and January all earned twice the amount of May and April, how much was earned in those three months?

Julie earns $1,600 per month. She has an investment account which adds 10% at the end of the month to the balance of the account. Assume that the investment account has an initial balance of $1,000, and Julie deposits 40% of her income in the middle of a month. What is the balance in the investment account at the end of the month?

Gail has a gym membership card, which gives her a special bonus if she buys 20 drinks. Each week, she only goes to the gym on Mondays, Tuesdays, Thursdays, Fridays, and Saturdays. She buys 1 drink on Monday, 2 drinks on Tuesday, 3 drinks on Thursday, 4 drinks on Friday, and 4 drinks on Saturday. Her buying pattern remains consistent from week to week. How many days of going to the gym does she need to buy a total of 20 drinks?

Jamie decides to organize her bookshelf by genre, and she has 4 different genres. She has twice as many adventure books as mystery books, and the number of fantasy books is the sum of adventure and mystery books. If Jamie has 12 mystery books and the number of science fiction books is half the number of fantasy books, how many books does Jamie have in total?

2 squirrels live in a tree. One of the squirrels gathers nuts, and the other eats them. The gathering squirrel replenishes their stock of nuts at a rate of 5 per hour. The eating squirrel eats the nuts at a rate of 3 per hour. After 6 hours, by how much will their stock of nuts increase?
Derek and Milo are having a fish-throwing competition. Derek was only able to throw his fish 75% as far as Milo. If Milo threw his fish 13 feet, how many inches further did he throw his than Derek?

Joey has 3 brothers and 1 sister. Taylor has twice as many sisters as Joey but half as many brothers as Kelby. Kelby's family only has boys and he has one more brother than Joey. How many total siblings do Joey, Taylor and Kelby have combined?
Adelaide solves six times as many problems in an hour as Aiden does. Aiden can solve 5 problems in an hour. If they worked on math problems for two hours, how many problems, together, did they solve?

Atharv is packing his suitcase for vacation and needs to make sure the final weight is under 30 pounds. Atharv is bringing 10 shirts which each weigh 0.5 pounds, 4 jackets which weigh three times as much as a shirt, toilettrees which weigh 10 pounds altogether, and his laptop which weighs 5 pounds. If pants weigh twice as much as a shirt how many can he bring to stay under the 30 pound weight limit?

Grant takes 3 minutes to put on his pajamas. He brushes his teeth for 2 minutes. Then, he washes his face and brushes his hair for another 2 minutes. Finally, he reads a book for a while and turns off the light for bed. If Grant begins his routine at 8:15 pm and turns off the lights at 8:47 pm, for how long does Grant read a book?

Matt decided he wanted to sign up for the hockey team. The school gave Matt a breakdown of the cost of everything he would need for the year. He needs five hockey sticks and fifty hockey pucks which cost a total of $350. Hockey pucks cost $2 each. The uniform is four times the amount of the cost of each hockey stick. Matt needs three uniforms. For his protective gear set, he needs five, where one costs $100. He needs four pairs of skates, each one costing $98. What is the total cost?

Jeremy has 15 gigabytes of storage on his USB. On Monday, he uses 1 gigabyte, on Tuesday he uses 2 more gigabytes, on Wednesday he frees up 1 gigabyte of space, on Thursday he uses 3 gigabytes, on Friday he frees up 4 gigabytes of space, on Saturday he uses 2 gigabytes, and on Sunday he uses 11 gigabytes. How many gigabytes of storage does Jeremy have to free up after Sunday if he has to maintain 3 gigabytes of storage as space for emergency uses?

Mary has a cat and a dog to feed. For each week, the cat needs 2 bags of cat food and the dog needs 3 bags of dog food. Each bag of cat food costs $10 while each bag of dog food costs $15. In addition, Mary buys 5 bottles of pure water for the pets and each bottle of water costs $3. How much in total, including pet food and water, does Mary spend weekly on feeding her cat and dog?
Benny saves $75 every time he gets paid weekly. How many weeks would he need to save to have over $1000?

Mary buys 6 yellow bananas and 8 green bananas. Each yellow banana weighs 0.5 pound and is sold at $2/pound. Each green banana weighs 0.75 pound and the unit price per pound is $0.5 lower than that of a yellow banana. How much in total does Mary spend on bananas?

Yesterday, Bob bought 2 stock shares. The first stock share was at the price of $10 and the second was $5 higher than the first one. Today, the first stock price drops down by 20% while the second stock price goes up by 20%. What is the total value of stock shares owned by Bob today?

Marty delivered eggs to the country store at the top of the mountain. On Day 1, he had 145 dozen eggs. On day 2, he had 155 dozen eggs. On day 3, he had 235 dozen eggs. Five percent of the eggs break due to the bumpy ride. How many eggs are not broken?

Sophia is hosting a large dinner for 100 people and needs to know how much money it will cost to feed everyone. She sent out invitations and asked her guests to choose between salmon, steak, or a vegan meal. 40 of the guests chose the vegan meal, half of the total guests chose steak, and the rest of the guests chose salmon. All of the meals come with 1 serving of rice and vegetables. Sophia went to the store and for 2 portions of salmon it cost $10, 4 portions of the vegan meal cost $20, and 2 portions of steak cost $15. The total cost of rice and vegetables for all guests is $400. How much will it cost for Sophia to host her dinner?

Aaron, Jacqueline, and Timothy work at the chocolate factory. Aaron filled 2,563 boxes of chocolate with 18 pieces of chocolate per box. Jacqueline filled 5,346 boxes of chocolate with 24 pieces of chocolate per box. Timothy filled 4,632 boxes of chocolate with 36 pieces of chocolate per box. How many pieces of chocolate did they fill in all?

Albert wants to drive his friend Jean to school. His car can drive 25 miles per gallon. Gas currently costs $4 per gallon. To pick up Jean, he must drive 20 miles. Then he must drive 30 miles to get to school. How much will this trip cost Albert?

Jason is buying watermelons and bananas for a celebration he is having at home. He sees that watermelons cost $4 and bananas cost $2. If he buys 7 watermelons and 5 bananas, how much did Jason spend in dollars?

Bea, Roger, Alex, Carol, Jody, Gerald, and Simon are a family of giants and all measure their height. Bea is 4ft tall, Roger is 3 times as tall as Bea, Carol is 1/2 as tall as Roger, and Alex is 1.5 times taller than Carol. Jody is taller than Alex by 3 feet, Gerald is 1/2 as tall as Jody, and Simon is 4ft taller than Gerald. How tall is Simon?

3 families of 4 people shared a vacation rental for 7 days. Everyone uses 1 oversized beach towel a day before getting a new one. The washing machine can hold 14 oversized beach towels per load. How many loads of laundry will it take to wash all the oversized beach towels if they are all washed in one day?

Dallas is projected to experience 2 inches of rainfall every day. The Trinity River is already at a depth of 30 ft, and with every inch of rain, it rises ½ a foot. When the depth reaches 40 feet, the surrounding homes must evacuate the area. If it continues to rain at the same rate, how many days will it take for the river to reach 40 feet of depth?

The first week of February, Shauna works out for 30 minutes on Monday, 28 minutes on Tuesday, 44 minutes on Wednesday, 50 minutes on Thursday, 0 minutes on Friday, 30 minutes on Saturday, and 0 minutes on Sunday. The second week of February, Shauna works out for an average of 30 minutes per day. The third week of February, Shauna feels a boost of energy and works out for 40 minutes on Monday, 48 minutes on Tuesday, 60 minutes on Wednesday, 57 minutes on Thursdays, 44 minutes Friday, 35 minutes Saturday, and 52 minutes Sunday. The last week of February, Shauna averaged 48 minutes of exercise per day. What is Shauna's average workout time per day during the month of February (assuming there are 4 weeks, 28 days in February and it is NOT a leap year)?

Don is going to paint his room. He has four walls to paint. Two of the walls are 10 ft high by 5 ft long. The other two walls are 10 ft high by 4 ft long. Cans of paint cover 100 square feet of area. Each can of paint costs $12. How much will the paint cost? Round up to whole can of paint.

A school is ordering tablets and laptops for three classrooms. Each classroom will receive 4 tablets and 3 laptops. If each tablet costs $250 and each laptop costs $600, how much will the school spend in total for all three classrooms?

Shiro is taking part in a cake-eating contest. He has 10 minutes to eat as many cakes as he can. In the first 2 minutes, he eats four cakes. In the next 3 minutes, he eats two fewer than twice the first two minutes. In the last five minutes, he has half as many as he had in the first five minutes. How many cakes did Shiro eat in total?

Sam decides to plant apple trees on his 16 acres of lands. Trees that produce red apples are planted on 6 acres of lands, and each acre can produce 20 pounds of red apples every month. Trees that produce green apples are planted on the remaining lands, and each acre can produce 16 pounds of green apples every month. What is the total weight of apples that Sam will harvest every month?

Michael gets a paycheck of 2000 dollars a month. He pays a monthly rent of 900 dollars, spends 500 dollars on food each month, and spends 300 dollars on transportation. With the remaining money, Michael wants to get a gym membership that is 15 dollars a week. Assuming there are four weeks in a month, how much money would he have left if he were to get a gym membership?

Sammy Hagar can’t drive 55, and instead he goes 80 mph all the way from his house in North Fort Worth to Port Aransas, which is 400 miles. Sammy listens to Van Halen songs the entire way; if he listens to 20 songs in an hour, how many songs can he play during the trip? Assume Van Halen has recorded and produced hundreds of songs!

Robert is painting the walls of his room in a pattern that has 2 colors of triangles, 3 colors of rectangles, and a single background color. The triangles are red and green, and the rectangles are blue, orange, and yellow. The red triangles have an area of 2 square feet each, and there are 6 of them. The green triangles are 3 square feet each, and there are 4 of them. The blue, orange, and yellow rectangles are 2, 4, and 6 square feet each, respectively. There are 3 blue rectangles, 2 orange, and 5 yellow. If the total area of the walls being painted is 100 square feet, how much of the wall (in square feet) is painted in the background color?

This year, Stephen decided to plant another garden. He realized that only 9 of every 10 cucumber seeds he planted produced a cucumber plant. He found that 100% of the carrot seeds he planted produced a plant. Stephen planted 120 cucumber seeds and 75 carrot seeds. Last year Steven grew 230 plants. How many less plants did Stephen grow this year?

A class requires each of its students to read 25 books every year. Shreya has already read 7 so far. On average, a book takes her 12 hours to read. If she can read for 4 hours per day, how many days will it take her to finish the class requirement?

I have 30-minute work breaks and I want to run on the treadmill for 15 minutes, 3 out of 5 days in my work week. I average 177 calories every quarter hour I run on the treadmill at the 7.0-speed setting with no incline. How many calories am I going to burn if I follow through with my workout plan for 4 weeks?

Maddy buys $4000 worth of stocks in Company A and $5000 worth of stocks in Company B. She makes a 10 percent gain each month on Company A, and she holds the stock for three months. She makes a 10% loss each month on Company B for two months. In the third month, the stock price of Company B was frozen. What is the total dollar value of her stocks in companies A and B at the end of three months?

Kyle is selling snow cones for $2 each. The first day, he made $50, the second day he had double the customers as the first day, and the third day he made 1/4 of what he made the second day. How much money did Kyle make in total over these three days?
Ashley has three times as many candies as Sarah. Sarah has 10 less candies than half the amount of Emily's candy amount. If Emily has 50 candies, how many candies does Ashley have?

A karate class consisting of 6 black belts and 5 non-black belts was sent to a tournament. Their sensei found out that only 2/3 of the black belts and 4/5 of the non-black belts were performing katas. How many students were not performing katas?
Jake sells pizzas for $10 and bowls of pasta for $15. If Jake sold 8 pizzas for $80 and made $185 in total, how many bowls of pasta did he sell?

Dempsey works at as hospital as a nurse. He gets paid $30 an hour and he earns time and a half for overtime. He begins making overtime pay after 30 hours. If Dempsey works 37 hours in a week, how much money., in dollars, does he make?
Tony got a chocolate bar for his birthday. On his birthday, he ate 1/5 of the chocolate bar. The next day, he ate 3 more pieces. If his chocolate bar had 15 pieces total, how many pieces did he eat?

Fred is trying to calculate his current grade in a class. He has 4 types of grades: homework, classwork, quizzes, and exams. They are worth 10, 5, 25, and 60 percent of his final grade, respectively. His current grades in each category are 90% in homework, 60% in classwork, 100% on quizzes, and 85% for exams. What is his current grade?
Jonathan is writing a novel. He has written 164 pages in the past four days. His goal is to hit 500 pages after the next three days. How many pages per day does he need to write to reach his goal?
Mary has 8 red crayons and 6 blue crayons. She has two-thirds as many green crayons as blue crayons. She also has 3 white crayons and 2 black crayons. How many crayons does she have in total?

A small zoo has twice as many penguins as bears. There are 2 bears in the zoo. There are 3 more gorillas than penguins. There are 10 times as many tropical birds than bears, penguins, and gorillas combined. If each additional animal costs $50 per month to keep, and the zoo's other expenses total $8,000 per month, what is the total cost of running the zoo per month?

August's father agreed to give her 10 cents for each trash piece she removed from the yard. In total, August removed 20 trash heaps. 60% had 8 trash items. 10% had 1 piece, whereas 30% had 3. What were August's earnings in cents?
Charlene owns 12 rental properties, each of which were rented for $1650 per month. If all of the rental properties lose 15% of their rental value, what is the total amount lost per month?

Ian is ordering computers for new hires at his company. Ian has already ordered 250 computers but has been told that there are 75 more people hired. At $650 per computer, how much will Ian have spent in total for all new hires?
Vinny's history exam scores are 69, 81, 100, and 94. What's his exam average?
A bakery sells cakes and pies. They sold 60 cakes and 80 pies today. If each cake costs $15 and each pie costs $10, how much money did they make in total?

An aging computer system can complete 12 operations/minute. The maintainer of the system proposes an upgrade to a newer one that can complete the same amount of operations, but every second instead of every minute. If a typical per-day workload for the system involves 2 projects, each with 56 tasks that take 3 operations each to resolve, how much time (in seconds) will be saved over the old system in the first 7 days the new system is in place?

Brad is practicing the long jump for an upcoming track and field meet. Brad long jumps 75% as far as Lloyd, who jumps 82 inches. During a day of practice, Brad jumped for a total of 861 inches. How many jumps did Brad make on this day?

Billy, Bob, Sue, and Max work at a new car wash that dries all the customer’s vehicles. Management told the employees that it should take 5 minutes to fully towel dry an SUV and 3 minutes to fully dry a car. There are 6 SUVs and 4 cars in line. How many minutes will it take the group to dry all the vehicles?

Valeria is redoing her kitchen and needs to purchase the tile for her floors. The kitchen measures 144 square feet. The tile she wants to buy measures 3 feet by 2 feet. How many tiles will she need to buy to cover her floor?

Justin is a homesteader who has to figure out how many oxen he has to take on his cross-country voyage. If an ox costs $50 and can haul 300 kgs each, how much money would he have to spend to haul 750kg?

The cheerleaders at school practice every day for 2 hours on Monday through Friday. The football team practices one hour longer than the cheerleaders on Tuesday, but otherwise the same. The marching band practices every day of the week for 2 hours a day except for Sundays. The theatre group practices once a week for half the total time the marching band practices. The soccer team practices just like the football team but adds an hour to their practice on Thursday. How many more hours does the soccer team practice compared to the theatre group?
Paul has to buy a cake for his friend’s birthday. He sees a $40 cake marked as 50% off. He pays 10% more than the new price because of tax. How much does Paul pay for the cake?

Cassandra is baking desserts. It takes her 15 minutes to bake one batch of cookies and twice that amount of time to bake one batch of brownies. If a batch of cookies has 12 cookies and a batch of brownies has 10 brownies how many total desserts can she make in 5 hours?
Arthur has a rope that is 48 meters long. He cuts it into pieces that are each 6 meters long. He only needs half of what he's cut. How many pieces does Arthur take?
George puts $2.50 in a jar every day for 30 days. Then he spends $15 from the jar on food. How much money, in dollars, is left in the jar?
John has 4 oranges (0.5 pound each) and 2 apples ( 1.5 pounds each). Nancy has 4 bananas (2 pounds each) and 3 pears (3 pounds each). What is the total weight of John's and Nancy's fruits?

The pier is open for spring break. It costs $5 per adult and $3 per child to fish on the pier. Fishing rods are $5 each to rent. Bait costs $3. A sandwich costs $4 and a soda costs $3. Souvenir t-shirts are $12 and hats are $8. How much would it cost two parents and their child to go fishing, including pier access, bait and fishing rods, souvenir t-shirts and hats, and a sandwich and soda for each person?
The original price of a dress from Macy's was $100. The price was reduced by 25%. Then, another additional 60% reduction was done. What was the final price of the dress?
Jace wants to make $50 selling cookies this weekend. He sells each cookie for $2. On Saturday he sells 17 cookies. How many cookies does he need to sell on Sunday to meet his goal of $50?
A clothing manufacturer can produce 3 pairs of jeans per minute at the industrial factory. How many pairs of jeans can be produced in a 8 hour shift?

Taco Man at the taco stand had a piece of meat in his hand. His face lit up as he looked at his friend. "Did you want chicken or beef, or did I misunderstand?" The customer is right and doesn't eat light, so he ordered both tacos with beef tonight. Chicken is $4.50 and beef is $5. "The tip is $2," Taco Man demands. How much is this order on hand?

Kai is planning a trip and wants to find the hotel with the best value. Hotel A costs $200 a night plus a daily 6% sales tax and a $15 service fee. Hotel B costs $150 a night plus 6% sales tax and no service fee. Kai earns $20 off the nightly rate of Hotel A with his rewards program. If Kai is staying for two nights, how much money does he save by booking Hotel B?

Ronny buys a box of variety chips with 60 snack bags in each box. His box came with 1/6 spicy chips, 1/4 bbq chips, 1/3 cheese chips, 1/5 nacho cheese, 1/30 sour cream & onion, and the rest are salt & vinegar chips. How many salt & vinegar snack bags does Ronny have?

A group of friends like to play dice during recess at school. They use two dice in the game, each with six sides. In their game, if you roll a six on both dice, you score the total number on the dice plus 10; otherwise, you score the total number on the dice.
